  Awurade yɛ daapem Onyankopɔn,
    na ɔyɛ asase nyinaa yɛfoɔ.
  Ɔremmrɛ na ɔrentɔ bera,
    na ne nhunumu nni nhwehwɛmu.

Ɔma deɛ watɔ bera ahoɔden
    deɛ wayɛ mmerɛ nso, ɔto nʼahoɔden so.

Mpo, mmabunu brɛ, na wɔtɔ bera,
    na mmeranteɛ suntisunti hwehwe ase;

Nanso, wɔn a wɔn ani da Awurade so
    bɛnya ahoɔden foforɔ.
  Wɔde ntaban te sɛ akɔdeɛ deɛ bɛtu akɔ ewiem;
    wɔbɛtu mmirika, na wɔremmrɛ.
    Wɔbɛnante, na wɔrentɔ baha.

“Monyɛ komm wɔ mʼanim, mo nsupɔ!
    Ma aman no nhyɛ wɔn ho den!
  Ma wɔmmra ha mmɛkasa;
    momma yɛn mmom nhyia mu wɔ asɛnniiɛ hɔ.

“Hwan na wakanyane deɛ ɔfiri apueeɛ no,
    afrɛ no tenenee mu sɛ ɔmmɛsom no?
  Ɔde aman hyɛ ne nsa
    na ɔbrɛ ahemfo ase wɔ nʼanim.
  Ɔde nʼakofena ma wɔdane mfuturo,
    ɔde ne bɛma ma wɔdane ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ hwete.

Ɔtaa wɔn na ɔkɔ nʼanim a biribiara enti ne ho,
    wɔ ɛkwan a ɔmfaa so da so.

Hwan na wayɛ yei akɔsi awieeɛ,
    afrɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ afiri mfitiaseɛ?
  Me Awurade, mene Ahyɛaseɛ
    ne Awieeɛ no. Mene ɔno ara.”

na obiara boa ne yɔnko
    na ɔka kyerɛ ne nua sɛ, “Yɛ den!”

Odwumfoɔ hyɛ sikadwumfoɔ nkuran,
    na deɛ ɔde asaeɛ yɛ no tromtrom
    boa deɛ ɔbɔ atomboɔ so.
  Ɔka fa ɔsɔ no ho sɛ, “Ɛyɛ pa ara.”
    Ɔbobɔ ohoni no mu nnadewa sɛdeɛ ɛrentu nhwe fam.

“Nanso wo, Ao Israel, me ɔsomfoɔ,
    Yakob, deɛ mayi no no,
    mo, mʼadamfo Abraham asefoɔ.

Mefaa wo firi nsase ano,
    firi nʼakyirikyiri ntweaso, na mefrɛɛ wo.
  Mekaa sɛ, ‘Woyɛ me ɔsomfoɔ’;
    mapa wo na me ne wo wɔ hɔ.

“Wɔn a wɔn bo afu wo no nyinaa, ampa ara
    wɔn ani bɛwu na wɔn anim agu ase;
  wɔn a wɔtia wo no
    rensɛ hwee na wɔbɛwu.

Ɛwom sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ wʼatamfoɔ deɛ,
    nanso worenhunu wɔn.
  Wɔn a wɔtu wo so sa no
    rensɛ hwee koraa.

Na mene Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn,
    deɛ ɔkura wo nsa nifa mu
  na ɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ, nsuro;
    mɛboa wo.

Nsuro, Ao, ɔsonsono Yakob,
    Ao Israel a wo sua,
  na mʼankasa mɛboa wo,” Awurade na ɔseɛ,
    wo gyefoɔ, Israel Ɔkronkronni no.

“Hwɛ, mede wo bɛyɛ nhusoɔ apa,
    a ɛyɛ mono, ano yɛ nnam na ɛwɔ ɛse bebree.
  Wobɛhuhu mmepɔ no so na woadwiri wɔn,
    na woama nkokoɔ ayɛ sɛ ntɛtɛ.

Wobɛhuhu wɔn so, mframa bɛma wɔn so,
    na ahum abɔ wɔn akɔ.
  Nanso wʼani bɛgye wɔ Awurade mu
    na woahyɛ Israel Ɔkronkronni no animuonyam.

“Ohiani ne mmɔborɔni kyini pɛ nsuo,
    nanso ebi nni hɔ;
    osukɔm ama wɔn tɛkrɛma so awe.
  Nanso me Awurade, mɛma wɔn mmuaeɛ.
    Me, Israel Onyankopɔn, merennya wɔn.

Mɛma nsubɔntene atene wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea bonini no so,
    na nsutire apue wɔ bɔnhwa mu.
  Mɛdane anweatam ayɛ no nsubura,
    na nsase a awo adane nsutire bebree.

Mɛduadua wɔ anweatam so,
    ntweneduro, okuo, ohwam ne ngo nnua.
  Mɛduadua pepeaa, wɔ asase wesee so
    asɛsɛ ne kwabɔhɔrɔ abɔ mu,

sɛdeɛ nnipa bɛhunu na wɔate,
    na wɔasusu ho na wɔate aseɛ sɛ,
  Awurade nsa na ayɛ saa adeɛ yi;
    Israel ɔkronkronni no na ɔma ɛbaeɛ.

“Bɔ wo nkuro,” Awurade na ɔseɛ.
    “Kyerɛkyerɛ wʼasɛm mu,” Yakob Ɔhene na ɔseɛ.

“Fa wʼahoni no bra
    na wɔmmɛka deɛ ɛbɛsi nkyerɛ yɛn.
  Wɔmmɛka sɛdeɛ na kane nneɛma no teɛ nkyerɛ yɛn,
    sɛdeɛ yɛbɛdwene ho afa
    na yɛahunu deɛ ɛbɛfiri mu aba.
  Anaa sɛ wɔmpae mu nka nneɛma a ɛbɛsi nkyerɛ yɛn.

Monka nkyerɛ yɛn deɛ ɛbɛsi daakye,
    na ama yɛahunu sɛ moyɛ anyame.
  Monyɛ biribi, sɛ ɛyɛ anaa ɛnyɛ,
    sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a yɛn aba mu bɛbu na ehu aka yɛn.

“Makanyane obi a ɔfiri atifi fam na ɔreba,
    deɛ ɔfiri owia apueeɛ na ɔbɔ me din.
  Ɔtiatia sodifoɔ so te sɛ dɔteɛ a wɔde si dan,
    te sɛ ɔnwomfoɔ a ɔrewɔ dɔteɛ.

Hwan na ɔkaa yei ho asɛm firii ahyɛaseɛ, sɛdeɛ anka ɛbɛma yɛahunu,
    anaa waka ato hɔ, sɛdeɛ yɛbɛtumi aka sɛ, ‘Ne deɛ no yɛ’?
  Obiara anka yei,
    obiara anni ɛkan anka,
    obiara ante nsɛm biara amfiri wo nkyɛn.

Me na medii ɛkan ka kyerɛɛ Sion, ‘Hwɛ, wɔn nie!’
    Mɛma Yerusalem ɔsomafoɔ bi a ɔde asɛmpa bɛba.

Mehwɛ nanso obiara nni hɔ,
    obiara nni wɔn mu a ɔbɛtu wɔn fo,
    sɛ mebisa wɔn a, obiara ntumi mma mmuaeɛ.

“Me ɔsomfoɔ a mahyɛ no den nie,
    deɛ mayi noɔ na ɔsɔ mʼani;
  mede me Honhom bɛgu no so
    na ɔde atɛntenenee bɛbrɛ aman no.

Ɔrenteam anaa ɔremma ne nne so.
    Ɔremma ne nne so wɔ mmɔntene so.

ɔrenhinhim na nʼabamu remmu
  kɔsi sɛ ɔde tenenee bɛba asase so.
    Ne mmara so na amanaman no de wɔn ani bɛtoɔ.”

Yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn, Awurade no seɛ,
  deɛ ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro na ɔtrɛɛ mu,
    deɛ ɔtwee asase mu ne deɛ ɛfiri mu nyinaa,
  deɛ ɔma wɔn a wɔte so ahome,
    na ɔma wɔn a wɔnante soɔ no nkwa:

“Me, Awurade, mafrɛ wo tenenee mu;
    mɛsɔ wo nsa.
  Mɛhwɛ wo so na mede wo ayɛ
    apam ama nkurɔfoɔ no
    ne kanea ama amanamanmufoɔ,

na woabue ani a afira,
    na woayi nneduafoɔ afiri afiase
    na woagye wɔn a wɔda afiase amena mu, wɔn a wɔte esum kabii mu no.

“Mene Awurade; me din ne no!
    Meremfa mʼanimuonyam mma obi
    anaa mʼayɛyie mma ahoni.

Hwɛ, nneɛma dada no atwam,
    na nneɛma foforɔ no mepae mu ka;
  ansa na ɛbɛba mu no
    meka kyerɛ mo.”

Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade!
    Nʼayɛyie mfiri asase ano,
  mo a mokɔ ɛpo so ne deɛ ɛwo mu nyinaa,
    mo nsupɔ ne wɔn a wɔtete so nyinaa.

Ma wɔnhyɛ Awurade animuonyam;
    na wɔmpae mu nka nʼayɛyie no wɔ nsupɔ no so.

Awurade bɛpue aba sɛ ɔkatakyie,
    te sɛ ɔkofoni no, ɔbɛhyɛ ne mmɔdemmɔ mu den;
  ɔde nteam bɛyɛ ɔkofrɛ
    na ɔbɛdi nʼatamfoɔ so nkonim.

“Mayɛ komm akyɛre,
    mayɛ dinn na mahyɛ me ho so.
  Nanso, afei, te sɛ ɔbaa a ɔrewoɔ no,
    meteam, mehome a ɛnsi so na mehome ɔherɛ so.

Mɛsɛe mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ no
    na mahye ɛso afifideɛ nyinaa.
  Mɛdane nsubɔntene ma ayɛ nsupɔ,
    na mama atadeɛ awewe.

Mɛdi anifirafoɔ anim afa ɛkwan a wɔnnim so,
    akwan a wɔnnim so papa so na mɛkyerɛ wɔn kwan.
  Mɛma esum no ayɛ hann wɔ wɔn anim,
    na mayɛ mmea a ɛyɛ mmomkyi mmɔnka no tromtrom.
  Yeinom ne nneɛma a mɛyɛ;
    merennya wɔn mu.

Na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to ahoni so,
    na wɔka kyerɛ nsɛsodeɛ sɛ, ‘Moyɛ yɛn anyame’ no,
    mɛpam wɔn animguaseɛ mu.”

“Tie, wo ɔsotifoɔ;
    hwɛ, wo onifirani na hunu!

Hwan ne ɔnifirafoɔ sɛ me ɔsomfoɔ,
    na ɔyɛ ɔsotifoɔ sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a mesoma noɔ?
  Hwan na nʼani afira sɛ deɛ ɔde ne werɛ ahyɛ me mu?
    Anaa hwan na nʼani afira sɛ Awurade ɔsomfoɔ?

Woahunu nneɛma bebree, nanso amfa wo ho;
    Wʼasom da ɛkwan, nanso wonte hwee.”

Ɛsɔɔ Awurade ani
    ne tenenee enti
    sɛ ɔbɛma ne mmara ayɛ kɛseɛ na anya animuonyam.

Nanso saa nnipa a wɔawia wɔn na wɔafo wɔn yi,
    wɔn nyinaa aka amena mu
    anaa wɔde wɔn asie wɔ nneduadan mu.
  Wɔayɛ wɔn afodeɛ
    na wɔnni obi a ɔbɛgye wɔn;
  wɔayɛ wɔn korɔnodeɛ
    na wɔnni obi a ɔbɛka sɛ, “Momfa wɔn nsane nkɔ.”

Mo mu hwan na ɔbɛtie yei
    anaa ɔbɛdwene ho yie akyire yi?

Hwan na ɔde Yakob maa sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ korɔnodeɛ,
    na ɔde Israel maa afomfoɔ?
  Ɛnyɛ Awurade a
    yɛayɛ bɔne atia no no?
  Ɛfiri sɛ wɔannante nʼakwan so;
    na wɔanni ne mmara so.

Enti ɔhwiee nʼabufuhyeɛ guu wɔn so,
    akodie mu basabasayɛ.
  Ɛde egyadɛreɛ bunkam wɔn so, nanso wɔante aseɛ.
    Ɛhyee wɔn, nanso amfa wɔn ho.

Sɛ wofa nsuo mu a,
    mɛka wo ho;
  na sɛ wotwa nsubɔntene no a,
    ɛremmu mfa wo so.
  Sɛ wonante ogya no mu a,
    worenhye;
    ogyaframa no renhye wo.

Na mene Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn,
    Israel Kronkronni, wo Agyenkwa.
  Mede Misraim yɛ mpata ma wo
    na mede Kus ne Seba si wʼananmu mu.

Sɛ wo som bo ma me na wowɔ animuonyam wɔ mʼanim
    na medɔ wo enti,
  mede nnipa bɛsesa wo,
    na mede nkurɔfoɔ asesa wo nkwa.

Mɛka akyerɛ atifi fam sɛ, ‘Monnyaa wɔn!’
    ne anafoɔ fam sɛ, ‘Monnye wɔn ntena ha.’
  Momfa me mmammarima mfiri akyirikyiri mmra
    na me mmammaa mfiri asase ano mmra,

obiara a me din da no so,
    deɛ mebɔɔ no de hyɛɛ me ho animuonyam,
    deɛ menwenee no na meyɛɛ no.”

Momfa wɔn a wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ
    wɔn a wɔwɔ aso nanso asisi no mmra.

Aman no nyinaa boa wɔn ho ano
    na nnipa no hyia mu.
  Wɔn mu hwan na ɔkaa yei firii ahyɛaseɛ
    na ɔpaee mu kaa nneɛma a atwam no kyerɛɛ yɛn?
  Ma wɔmmfa wɔn adansefoɔ mmra mmɛdi adanseɛ sɛ wɔdi bem,
    sɛdeɛ afoforɔ bɛte na wɔaka sɛ, “Ɛyɛ nokorɛ.”

“Mone mʼadansefoɔ, ne me ɔsomfoɔ a mapa no,”
    sei na Awurade seɛ,
  “sɛdeɛ mobɛhunu na moagye me adie
    na moate aseɛ sɛ me ne no.
  Wɔammɔ onyame bi anni mʼanim,
    na mʼakyi nso obiara remma.

Me, Me ara, Mene Awurade,
    na agyenkwa biara nni hɔ sɛ me.

Mada no adi na magye nkwa na mapae mu aka sɛ,
    Me, na ɛnyɛ onyame nanani bi a ɔwɔ mo mu.
  Mone mʼadansefoɔ,” Awurade na ɔseɛ sɛ, “Mene Onyankopɔn.

Aane, na ɛfiri teteete no mene no.
    Obiara rentumi nye mfiri me nsa mu
  sɛ meyɛ biribi a, hwan na ɔbɛtumi adane no?”

Sei na Awurade seɛ,
    wʼAgyenkwa, Israel Kronkronni no:
  “Mo enti, mɛsoma akɔ Babilonia,
    na mede Babiloniafoɔ nyinaa bɛba sɛ adwanefoɔ,
    wɔ ahyɛn a wɔde hoahoa wɔn ho no mu.

Mene Awurade, wo Kronkronni no,
    Israel Yɛfoɔ, wo Ɔhene.”

Yei na Awurade seɛ,
    deɛ ɔbɔɔ ɛkwan wɔ ɛpo mu,
    ɛkwan a ɛda nsubunu mu,

deɛ ɔtwee nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ,
    akodɔm ne ne nkekahoɔ nyinaa,
  na wɔkaa hɔ a wɔansɔre bio;
    wɔadum wɔn te sɛ kanea mu ntoma:

“Momma mo werɛ mfiri kane nneɛma no
    monntɔ nkɔ deɛ atwam no so.

Hwɛ, mereyɛ adeɛ foforɔ!
    Seesei, ɛrepue, na monhunu anaa?
  Merebɔ ɛkwan afa anweatam so
    na mereyɛ nsuwansuwa wɔ asase wesee so.

Mmoa a wɔyɛ keka hyɛ me animuonyam,
    adompo ne apatuo,
  ɛfiri sɛ mema nsuo wɔ anweatam so
    ne nsuwansuwa wɔ asase wesee so
    de ma me nkurɔfoɔ, wɔn a mapa wɔn no nsuo,

nnipa a meyɛɛ wɔn maa me ho
    sɛ wɔmpae mu nka mʼayɛyie.

“Nanso, womfrɛɛ me, Ao Yakob,
    wonhaa wo ho wɔ me ho, Ao Israel.

Momfaa nnwan mmrɛɛ me sɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ,
    na momfaa mo afɔrebɔ nhyɛɛ me animuonyam nso.
  Memmaa aduane afɔdeɛ nyɛɛ mo adesoa
    na memfaa nnuhwamgyeɛ nhaa mo.

Montɔɔ nnuhwam mmrɛɛ me,
    na mommaa mo afɔrebɔdeɛ mu sradeɛ mmuu me so.
  Mmom, mode mo bɔne asoa me
    na mode mo mfomsoɔ ho haw abɛtɔ me so.

“Me, me ara, mene deɛ ɔpepa
    mo bɔne, me enti,
    na menkae mo amumuyɛ bio.

Mo agya a ɔdii ɛkan no yɛɛ bɔne;
    mo kasamafoɔ tee mʼanim atua.

Enti magu mo asɔredan mu atitire anim ase,
    na mede Yakob ama ɔsɛeɛ,
    na mede Israel ama ahɔhora.

“Na, afei, Ao Yakob me ɔsomfoɔ,
    Israel, deɛ mapa no.

Sei na Awurade seɛ,
    deɛ ɔnwonoo wo, na ɔyɛɛ wo wɔ awotwaa mu,
    ɔno na ɔbɛboa wo:
  Nsuro, Ao Yakob, me ɔsomfoɔ,
    Yeshurun, a mapa noɔ.

Na mɛhwie nsuo agu asase a awo no so,
    ne asutene wɔ asase kesee so;
  mɛhwie me Honhom agu wo mma so,
    ne me nhyira agu wʼasefoɔ so.

Wɔbɛfifiri sɛdeɛ ɛserɛ fifiri wɔ mmoa adidibea,
    te sɛ mpampuro a ɛwɔ asutene ho.

“Sei na Awurade
    Israelhene ne Ɔgyefoɔ, Asafo Awurade seɛ:
  Mene Ahyɛaseɛ ne Awieeɛ;
    Onyankopɔn biara nni hɔ sɛ me.

Hwan na ɔne me sɛ? Ma ɔmpae mu nka.
    Ma ɔnka na ɔnkyerɛ wɔ mʼanim
  deɛ asisi firi ɛberɛ a megyee me tete nkurɔfoɔ sii hɔ,
    ne deɛ ɛrebɛba,
    aane, ma ɔnhyɛ deɛ ɛreba ho nkɔm.

Mommma mo ho mpopo, monnsuro.
    Mampae mu anka yei, manna no adi teteete anaa?
  Mone mʼadansefoɔ. Onyankopɔn foforɔ bi ka me ho anaa?
    Dabi, Ɔbotan foforɔ bi nni hɔ; mennim obiara.”

Wɔn a wɔyɛ ahoni nyinaa nka hwee,
    na nneɛma a ɛsom wɔn bo no ho nni mfasoɔ.
  Wɔn a anka wɔkasa ma wɔn no ani afira;
    wɔnnim wɔn ankasa animguaseɛ ho hwee.

Hwan na ɔsene onyame na ɔgu ohoni,
    a ne ho mma no mfasoɔ biara?

Ɔno ne wɔn a wɔte sɛ no nyinaa anim bɛgu ase;
    adwumfoɔ nyɛ hwee sɛ nnipa.
  Momma wɔn nyinaa mmɔ mu nsɔre nnyina,
    ehu ne animguaseɛ na ɛbɛka wɔn.

Duadwumfoɔ de ahoma susu
    na ɔde twerɛdua sensane;
  na ɔde fitiɛ yiyi ho
    afei ɔde kɔmpase hyɛ no agyiraeɛ.
  Ɔsene na ɛyɛ sɛ onipa sɛso,
    ɛyɛ sɛ onipa wɔ nʼanimuonyam nyinaa mu,
    sɛ wɔde bɛsi abosonnan mu.

Ɔtwitwaa ntweneduro,
    anaasɛ ebia ɔfaa kwabɔhɔrɔ anaa odum.
  Ɔmaa ɛnyiniiɛ wɔ kwaeɛ mu,
    anaa ɔduaa pepeaa, na osutɔ ma ɛnyiniiɛ.

Ɔde dua no mu fa sɔ ogya;
    ɛso na ɔnoa nʼaduane,
    ɔtoto ne nam wɔ so na wawe amee.
  Afei ɔka ne ho hye na ɔka sɛ,
    Aa! Mahunu ogya; me ho ayɛ me hye.

Nkaeɛ no ɔde yɛ onyame, ne honi;
    ɔkoto no na ɔsɔre no.
  Ɔbɔ no mpaeɛ sɛ,
    “Gye me; wone me nyame.”

Obiara nna nnwene ho,
    obiara nni nimdeɛ anaa nhunumu a ɔde bɛka sɛ,
  “Mede ɛfa sɔɔ ogya;
    na mpo metoo burodo wɔ ne gyaframa so;
    metotoo nam wɔ so weeɛ.
  Ɛsɛ sɛ mede nkaeɛ no yɛ akyiwadeɛ anaa?
    Ɛsɛ sɛ mekoto gyentia anaa?”

“Kae saa nneɛma yi, Ao, Yakob,
    ɛfiri sɛ, woyɛ me ɔsomfoɔ, Ao Israel.
  Me na meyɛɛ wo, woyɛ me ɔsomfoɔ;
    Ao Israel, me werɛ remfiri wo.

Mapra wo mfomsoɔ agu te sɛ ɛbɔ
    ne wo bɔne te sɛ anɔpa bosuo.
  Sane bra me nkyɛn,
    ɛfiri sɛ magye wo.”

Momfa ahosɛpɛ nto dwom, Ao ɔsorosoro,
    na Awurade na wayɛ yei.
  Mommɔ ose, Ao, asase ase.
    Momma nnwontoɔ so, mo mmepɔ,
  mo kwaeɛ ne emu nnua nyinaa,
    na Awurade agye Yakob,
    wada nʼanimuonyam adi wɔ Israel.

“Sei na Awurade seɛ,
    wo Gyefoɔ a ɔnwonoo wo wɔ awotwaa mu no:
    
  “Mene Awurade,
    deɛ wayɛ nneɛma nyinaa,
  deɛ ɔno nko ara trɛɛ ɔsoro mu
    deɛ ɔno nko ara twee asase mu,

deɛ ɔsɛe atorɔ adiyifoɔ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ
    na ɔma nkɔmhyɛfoɔ yɛ nkwaseafoɔ;
  deɛ ɔtutu anyansafoɔ adenim guo
    na ɔdane no nkwaseasɛm,

deɛ ɔma nʼasomfoɔ nsɛm ba mu
    deɛ ɔhyɛ nʼasomafoɔ nkɔmhyɛ no mu ma,
    
  “deɛ ɔka fa Yerusalem ho sɛ, ‘Wɔbɛtena ne mu,’
    ne Yuda nkuro ho sɛ, ‘Wɔbɛkyekyere,’
    ne mmubuiɛ ho sɛ, ‘Mɛyɛ no foforɔ,’

deɛ ɔka kyerɛ nsubunu sɛ, ‘We,
    na mɛma wo asutene awewe,’

deɛ ɔka wɔ Kores ho sɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me dwanhwɛfoɔ
    na ɔbɛwie deɛ mepɛ nyinaa yɛ;
    ɔbɛka afa Yerusalem ho sɛ, “Ma wɔnkyekyere bio,”
    na waka afa asɔredan no ho sɛ, “Ma wɔnto ne fapem.” ’ ”

“Yei ne deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛ deɛ wasra no ngo,
    Kores a wasɔ ne nsa nifa mu
  sɛ ɔmmrɛ aman ase wɔ nʼanim
    na ɔnnye ahemfo akodeɛ mfiri wɔn nsam
  na ɔmmuebue apono a ɛwɔ nʼanim
    sɛdeɛ kuro apono no mu rentoto.

Mɛdi wʼanim
    mɛyɛ mmepɔ no asase tamaa;
  mɛbubu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ apono agu
    na matwitwa dadeɛ adaban mu.

Mede esum mu ademudeɛ bɛma wo
    ahonyadeɛ a wɔde asie kɔkoam
  sɛdeɛ wobɛhunu sɛ, mene Awurade,
    Israel Onyankopɔn, a ɔbɔ wo din frɛ woɔ.

Me ɔsomfoɔ Yakob enti,
    Israel a mapa no enti,
  mebɔ wo din frɛ wo
    na mɛma wo animuonyamhyɛ abodin,
    ɛwom sɛ wonnyee me ntoo mu deɛ.

Mene Awurade, obiara nni hɔ bio;
    Onyankopɔn biara nni hɔ ka me ho.
  Ɛwom sɛ wonnyee me ntoo mu deɛ,
    nanso mɛhyɛ wo den,

sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛfiri deɛ owia pue
    kɔsi beaeɛ a ɛtɔ no
  nnipa bɛhunu sɛ obiara nka me ho.
    Mene Awurade, na obiara nni hɔ bio.

“Nnome nka deɛ ɔne ne Yɛfoɔ ham
    Ɛnka deɛ ɔmfra te sɛ kyɛmferɛ a ɛfra deɛ ɛgugu fam mu.
  Dɔteɛ bɛtumi abisa ɔnwomfoɔ sɛ,
    ‘ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi?’
  Wo nsa ano adwuma bɛtumi abisa wo sɛ,
    ‘Wonni nsa’?

Nnome nka deɛ ɔse nʼagya sɛ
    ‘Adɛn enti na wowoo me?’
  Anaa ɔbisa ne maame sɛ,
    ‘Adɛn enti na wokyem me woeɛ?’

“Sei na Awurade seɛ,
    Israel Ɔkronkronni ne ne Yɛfoɔ;
  ɛfa nneɛma a ɛreba ho no.
    Wobisa me nsɛm a ɛfa me mma ho,
    anaa wohyɛ me wɔ me nsa ano adwuma ho?

Ɛyɛ me na meyɛɛ asase
    na mebɔɔ adasamma guu so.
  Me ara me nsa na mede trɛɛ ɔsoro mu;
    nsoromma ahodoɔ nyinaa hyɛ mʼase.

Mɛma Kores so wɔ me tenenee mu;
    mɛtenetene nʼakwan nyinaa.
  Ɔbɛsane akyekyere me kuropɔn
    na wagyaa mʼatukɔfoɔ,
  nanso ɔrennye akatua anaa akyɛdeɛ,
    Asafo Awurade na ɔseɛ.”

Sei na Awurade seɛ:
  “Nneɛma a ɛfiri Misraim ne adwadeɛ a ɛfiri Kus,
    ne Sebafoɔ atentene no,
  wɔbɛba wo nkyɛn
    abɛyɛ wo dea;
  wɔbɛdi wʼakyi brɛoo aba a
    wɔgu nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu.
  Wɔbɛbu nkotodwe wʼanim
    na wɔasrɛ wo aka sɛ,
  ‘Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn ka wo ho, na ɔbi nni hɔ;
    onyame biara nni hɔ.’ ”

Ampa ara, woyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔde ne ho sie,
    Ao Onyankopɔn ne Israel Agyenkwa.

Wɔn a wɔyɛ ahoni nyinaa bɛfɛre na wɔn anim agu ase;
    wɔbɛbɔ mu akɔ animguaseɛ mu.

Nanso, Awurade bɛgye Israel nkwa,
    ɔde daapem nkwagyeɛ;
  Wɔremma wʼani nwu na wʼanim renguase bio
    kɔsi daapem.

Na sei na Awurade seɛ,
    deɛ ɔbɔɔ ɔsorosoro no
  ɔno ne Onyankopɔn;
    deɛ ɔmaa asase, na ɔbɔeɛ no,
  ɔno na ɔtoo ne fapem;
    wammɔ no sɛ ɛso nna hɔ kwa,
  mmom ɔyɛeɛ sɛ nnipa ntena so,
    ɔka sɛ:
  “Me ne Awurade,
    na obi nni hɔ.

“Mommoaboa mo ho ano na mommra;
    monhyia mu, mo adwanefoɔ a mofiri amanaman so,
  mo a monnim de na moasoa nnua ahoni de kyinkyini,
    mo a mobɔ anyame a wɔntumi nnye nkwa no mpaeɛ.

Mompae mu nka deɛ ɛbɛsi. Momfa nto dwa
    na wɔn mmɔ mu ntu agyina.
  Hwan na ɔdii ɛkan kaa no teteete,
    hwan na ɔdaa no adi firi tete nteredee?
  Ɛnyɛ me Awurade anaa?
    Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ ka me ho,
  tenenee Onyankopɔn ne Agyenkwa;
    obiara nni hɔ sɛ me.

Maka me ho ntam,
    mʼano aka wɔ nokorɛdie nyinaa mu,
    asɛm a wɔntwe nsane sɛ:
  obiara bɛbu nkotodwe wɔ mʼanim.
    Na obiara bɛpae mu aka sɛ, mene Onyankopɔn.

Wɔbɛka me ho asɛm sɛ, ‘Awurade nko ara mu
    na tenenee ne ahoɔden wɔ.’ ”
  Wɔn a wɔn bo huru tia no nyinaa
    bɛba ne nkyɛn na wɔn anim bɛgu ase.

Nanso Awurade mu,
    wɔbɛbu Israel asefoɔ nyinaa bem,
    na wɔahoahoa wɔn ho.

Bel bɔ ne mu ase, Nebo kuntun ne mu;
    mfunumu soa wɔn ahoni.
  Nsɛsodeɛ a wɔso nenam no mu yɛ duru,
    ɛyɛ adesoa ma deɛ wabrɛ.

“Montie me, Ao Yakob fiefoɔ,
    mo a moaka wɔ Israel efie nyinaa,
  mo a masɔ mo mu firi mo nyinsɛn mu,
    na maturu mo afiri ɛberɛ a wɔwoo mo.

Mpo kɔsi mo nkɔkoraa berɛ ne ɛberɛ a mobɛfu dwono mu,
    Me ne no, Me ne deɛ ɔbɛsɔ mo mu.
  Mabɔ mo na mɛturu mo;
    mɛwowa mo na mɛgye mo.

“Hwan ho na mode me bɛto, anaa mobɛbu no me sɛso?
    Hwan na mode me bɛsusu no, na mode ayɛ mfatoho?

Ebinom hwie sikakɔkɔɔ firi wɔn mmɔtɔ mu
    na wɔkari dwetɛ wɔ nsania so;
  wɔbɔ sika dwumfoɔ paa, ma ɔde yɛ onyame bi,
    na wɔkoto sɔre no.

Wɔsoa no wɔ wɔn mmatire so,
    wɔde kɔsi nʼafa, na ɛka hɔ ara.
    Ɛrentumi mfiri faako a esie.
  Obi team frɛ no deɛ, nanso ɔmmua;
    ɛrentumi nyi no mfiri ne haw mu.

“Monkae no yie, momma ɛnka mo tirim,
    monnwene ho mo atuatefoɔ.

Meda awieeɛ adi firi ahyɛaseɛ,
    ɛfiri tete, meka deɛ ɛrennya mmaeɛ.
  Meka sɛ: Mʼatirimpɔ bɛgyina,
    na mɛyɛ deɛ mepɛ nyinaa.

Montie me, mo a moyɛ akokoɔdurufoɔ,
    mo a mo ne tenenee ntam ɛkwan ware;

Mede me tenenee repinkyɛ,
    ɛnni akyirikyiri;
    na me nkwagyeɛ nso, ɛrenkyɛre.
  Mɛma Sion nkwagyeɛ,
    na mede mʼanimuonyam ama Israel.

“Siane kɔ, tena mfuturo mu,
    Ɔbabaa bunu Babilonia;
  tena fam. Worentena ahennwa so bio,
    Ɔbabaa Babiloniafoɔ.
  Wɔremfrɛ wo bio sɛ,
    ɔbaabereɛ a wɔkorɔkorɔ no bio.

Fa owiyammoɔ na yam esiam;
    yi wo nkatanimu no.
  Pagya wʼatadeɛ kɔ soro, na wo nan ho ngu hɔ,
    na fa nsuwansuwa no mu.

Wʼadagya bɛda adi
    na wʼanimguaseɛ so renkata.
  Mɛtɔ were;
    memfa obiara ho nkyɛ no.”

Yɛn Gyefoɔ, Asafo Awurade ne ne din,
    ɔno ne Israel Kronkronni.

“Tena ase dinn, kɔhyɛ esum mu,
    Ɔbabaa Babilonia;
  wɔremfrɛ wo bio sɛ
    ahennie ahodoɔ so hemaa.

Me bo fuu me nkurɔfoɔ,
    na meguu mʼagyapadeɛ ho fi;
  mede wɔn hyɛɛ wo nsa,
    na woanhunu wɔn mmɔbɔ.
  Nkɔkoraa koraa mpo
    wosoaa wɔn kɔnnua duruduru.

Wokaa sɛ, ‘Mɛkɔ so daa,
    ayɛ ɔhemmaa afebɔɔ.’
  Nanso woannwene saa nneɛma yi ho
    na woansusu deɛ ɛbɛtumi asie ho.

“Afei tie, wo odwamanfoɔ,
    woredwodwo wo ho wɔ wo banbɔ mu
  na woka kyerɛ wo ho sɛ,
    ‘me ne no, na obiara nni hɔ sɛ me.
  Merenyɛ okunafoɔ da
    na merenni abawuo.’

Saa nneɛma mmienu yi bɛto wo
    prɛko pɛ, dakoro pɛ:
  abawuo ne kunayɛ.
    Saa nneɛma yi bɛba wo so pa ara,
  wʼabayisɛm bebrebe yi
    ne ntafowayie a emu yɛ den nyinaa akyi.

Wode wo ho ato wʼamumuyɛ so
    na waka sɛ, ‘Obiara nhunu me.’
  Wo nyansa ne nimdeɛ ma wo fom kwan
    ɛberɛ a woka kyerɛ wo ho sɛ,
    ‘Me ne no, obiara nni hɔ ka me ho.’

Amanehunu bɛto wo,
    na worenhunu ɛkwan ko a wobɛfa so ayi afiri hɔ.
  Ɔhaw bi bɛba wo so
    a worentumi mfa mpatadeɛ nyi mfiri hɔ;
  atoyerɛnkyɛm a ɛnnaa ne ho adi nkyerɛɛ wo
    bɛba wo so mpofirim.

“Kɔ so yɛ wo ntafowayie
    ne wʼabayisɛm bebrebe
    a wode adi dwuma firi wo mmɔfraase no.
  Ebia wobɛdi nkonim,
    ebia wode ehu bɛba.

Woabrɛ wɔ afotufoɔ bebrebe a woanya no mu!
    Ma wo nsoromma ho anyansafoɔ mmra anim,
  wɔn a wɔhwɛ nsoromma mu no ka deɛ ɛreba bosome biara mu no,
    ma wɔnnnye wo mfiri deɛ ɛreba wo so no mu.

Deɛ wɔbɛtumi ayɛ ama wo ara ne no,
    yeinom na wo ne wɔn abrɛ
    na wo ne wɔn anante firi mmɔfraase.
  Wɔn mu biara afa ne kwan;
    ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ a ɔbɛtumi agye woɔ.

“Montie yei, Ao, Yakob fiefoɔ
    mo a wɔde Israel din frɛ mo,
  na moyɛ Yuda asefoɔ,
    mo a mobɔ Awurade din ka ntam,
  na mofrɛ Israel Onyankopɔn,
    nanso ɛnyɛ nokorɛ anaa tenenee mu;

mo a mofrɛ mo ho kuro kronkron no mma
    na mode mo ho to Israel Onyankopɔn so.
    Asafo Awurade ne ne din.

Na menim sɛdeɛ moyɛ asoɔden.
    Mo kɔn ho ntini yɛ dadeɛ
    na mo moma yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ.

Enti, mekaa saa nneɛma yi kyerɛɛ mo dadaada.
    Ansa na ɛrebɛsisi no mebɔɔ mo nkaeɛ
  sɛdeɛ morentumi nka sɛ,
    ‘Mʼahoni na ɔyɛeɛ:
    me dua nsɛsodeɛ ne me dadeɛ nyame na ɔhyɛeɛ.’

Moate yeinom nyinaa; moahunu ne nyinaa.
    Morennye nto mu anaa?
    
  “Ɛfiri saa ɛberɛ yi de rekorɔ mɛka nneɛma foforɔ akyerɛ mo,
    nneɛma a ahinta a monnim.

Afei na ɛreba koraa, ɛnkyɛreɛ;
    ɛbɛsi ɛnnɛ no, na anka montee ho hwee da.
  Enti morentumi nka sɛ,
    ‘Aane na menim dada!’

Hwɛ, mahoa mo ho, nanso ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ wɔhoa dwetɛ ho;
    mmom, masɔ wo mahwɛ wɔ amanehunu fononoo mu.

Me enti, me enti, na meyɛ yei.
    Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ mema ho kwan na wɔsɛe me din?
    Memma obi nnye mʼanimuonyam.”

Me ara me nsa na ɛtoo asase fapem,
    na me nsa na ɛtrɛɛ ɔsorosoro mu;
  sɛ mefrɛ wɔn a,
    wɔn nyinaa bɔ mu sɔre.

“Mo nyinaa mommɔ mu mmra mmɛtie:
    ahoni no mu deɛ ɔwɔ he na waka saa nneɛma yi dada?
  Awurade ɔboafoɔ a wapa no
    bɛma nʼatirimpɔ a ɛtia Babilonia aba mu;
    ne basa bɛtia Babiloniafoɔ.

Me, me na makasa;
    aane, mafrɛ no.
  Mede no bɛba,
    na ɔbɛwie nʼadwuma nkonimdie so.

“Montwe mmɛn me na montie yei:
  “Ɛfiri nkaebɔ a ɛdi ɛkan no, menkasaa kɔkoam;
    ɛberɛ biara a ɛbɛsi no, na mewɔ hɔ.”
    
  Na afei Asafo Awurade
    de ne Honhom asoma me.

Yei ne deɛ Awurade seɛ,
    mo gyefoɔ, Israel Kronkronni no:
  “Mene Awurade mo Onyankopɔn,
    deɛ ɔkyerɛ mo deɛ ɛyɛ ma mo,
    na ɔkyerɛ mo ɛkwan a ɛsɛ sɛ mofa soɔ.

Sɛ modii mʼahyɛdeɛ so a,
    anka mo asomdwoeɛ ayɛ sɛ asubɔnten,
    na mo tenenee ayɛ sɛ ɛpo asorɔkye.

Anka mo asefoɔ ayɛ sɛ anwea,
    na mo mma ayɛ sɛ nʼaboseaa a wɔntumi nkane;
  wɔn din rempepa da.
    Wɔrensɛe mfiri mʼanim.”

Momfiri Babilonia,
    monnwane mfiri Babiloniafoɔ nkyɛn!
  Momfa osebɔ nteam mmɔ nkaeɛ
    na mo mpae mu nka yei.
  Momfa nkɔ nsase ano;
    monka sɛ, “Awurade abɛgye ne ɔsomfoɔ Yakob.”
“Asomdwoeɛ nni hɔ mma amumuyɛfoɔ.” Sei na Awurade seɛ.

Montie me, mo mpoano aman;
    monyɛ aso mo akyirikyiri aman
  ansa na wɔrebɛwo me no, Awurade frɛɛ me
    ɔbɔɔ me din ansa na wɔrewo me.

Ɔyɛɛ mʼano sɛ akofena nnamnnam,
  Ɔde me hintaa ne nsa ase nwunu mu;
    ɔde me yɛɛ agyan a ano yɛ nnam
    na ɔde me hyɛɛ ne bɔha mu.

Ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Woyɛ me ɔsomfoɔ,
    Israel, wo mu na mɛda mʼanimuonyam adi.”

Nanso mekaa sɛ, “Mabrɛ agu
    masɛe mʼahoɔden kwa, mannya mu hwee
  nanso mede me ho ato Awurade so
    na mʼakatua wɔ me Onyankopɔn nkyɛn.”

Na afei, Awurade akasa:
    deɛ ɔnwonoo me wɔ awotwaa mu sɛ memmɛyɛ ne ɔsomfoɔ
  na memfa Yakob nsane mmra ne nkyɛn
    na me mmoaboa Israel ano mma no no.
  Awurade ahyɛ me animuonyam
    na me Onyankopɔn ayɛ mʼahoɔden.

Ɔka sɛ,
  “Wobɛyɛ me ɔsomfoɔ a wode Yakob mmusuakuo bɛsane aba,
    na wode Israelfoɔ a mede wɔn asie nso bɛsane aba.
  Nanso, mɛma woayɛ amanamanmufoɔ nyinaa kanea,
    ɛnam wo so na wɔbɛgye ewiasefoɔ nyinaa nkwa.”

Sei na Awurade seɛ,
    Ɔgyefoɔ ne Israel Ɔkronkronni no
  de asɛm yi kɔma deɛ ɔman no buu no animtia na wɔkyirii no,
    deɛ ɔyɛ sodifoɔ ɔsomfoɔ no:
  “Ahene bɛhunu wo na wɔasɔre
    ahenemma bɛhunu wo na wɔakoto wo
  ɛsiane Awurade a ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ,
    Israel ɔkronkronni a wayi woɔ no enti.”

Sei na Awurade seɛ:
  “Ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu no, mɛbua wo,
    na nkwagyeɛ da no, mɛboa wo;
  mɛkora wo na mede wo ayɛ
    apam ama nkurɔfoɔ no,
  de agye asase no asi hɔ
    akyekyɛ agyapadeɛ ahodoɔ a asɛe no bio.

Wobɛka akyerɛ nneduafoɔ sɛ, ‘Momfiri mmra!’
    ne wɔn a wɔwɔ esum mu sɛ, ‘Momfa mo ho nni!’
    
  “Wɔbɛdidi wɔ akwan ho.
    Wɔbɛnya adidibea wɔ kokoɔ bonini biara so.

Ɛkɔm renne wɔn na osukɔm nso renne wɔn;
    anweatam so hyeɛ ne owia ano hyeɛ renka wɔn.
  Deɛ ɔwɔ ayamhyehyeɛ ma wɔn no bɛkyerɛ wɔn kwan
    na ɔde wɔn akɔ nsutire ho.

Mɛyɛ me mmepɔ nyinaa akwan,
    na mʼakwantempɔn nso mɛma akorɔn.

Hwɛ, wɔfiri akyirikyiri bɛba
    ebinom bɛfiri atifi fam, ebinom bɛfiri atɔeɛ fam
    ebinom nso bɛfiri Sinin mantam mu.”

Nanso, Sion kaa sɛ, “Awurade agya me hɔ,
    Awurade werɛ afiri me.”

“Ɔbaa werɛ bɛtumi afiri ne ba a ɔtua nufoɔ ano
    a ɔrennya ayamhyehyeɛ mma ɔba a waturu no anaa?
  Ebia ne werɛ bɛfiri,
    na me werɛ remfiri wo!

Hwɛ, makrukyire wo din agu me nsa yam
    wʼafasuo wɔ mʼani so daa.

Mo mmammarima resane aba ntɛm so;
    na wɔn a wɔsɛe mo no refiri mo nkyɛn akɔ.

Momma mo ani so na monhwɛ mo ho nhyia;
    mo mmammarima nyinaa reboa wɔn ho ano aba mo nkyɛn.
  Sɛ mete ase yi” sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ,
    “mode wɔn bɛyɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ ama mo ho
    mode wɔn bɛfira sɛ ayeforɔkunu.

“Ɛwom sɛ wɔsɛee mo yɛɛ mo pasaa
    maa mo asase daa mpan deɛ,
  nanso, afei nnipa bɛhyɛ mo so ma, ama aboro mo so,
    na wɔn a wɔsɛee mo no bɛkɔ akyirikyiri.

Mmɔfra a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ mo nnabɔne mu no
    bɛka ama moate sɛ,
  ‘Ɛha sua ma yɛn dodo;
    momma yɛn asase no bi nka ho na yɛntena so.’

Na wobɛka wɔ wʼakoma mu sɛ,
    ‘Hwan na ɔwoo yeinom maa me?
  Na meyɛ ɔwerɛhoni ne obonini;
    wɔtuu me kɔɔ asase foforɔ so na wɔpoo me.
    Hwan na ɔtetee yeinom?
  Wɔgyaa me nko ara
    na yeinom, ɛhe na wɔfiri baeɛ?’ ”

Sei na Asafo Awurade seɛ:
  “Hwɛ, mɛnyama amanamanmufoɔ,
    mɛpagya me frankaa no akyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ no.
  Wɔbɛturu mo mmammarima wɔ wɔn nsa so aba
    na wɔbɛsoa mo mmammaa wɔ wɔn mmatire so.

Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agye afodeɛ afiri akofoɔ nsam;
    anaa hwan na ɔbɛtumi agye nnommumfoɔ afiri otirimuɔdenfoɔ nsam?

Nanso, sei na Awurade seɛ:
  “Aane, mɛgye nnommumfoɔ afiri akofoɔ nsam
    na mɛgye afodeɛ afiri otirimuɔdenfoɔ nsam;
  me ne wɔn a wɔne mo nya no bɛnya
    na mɛgye mo mma nkwa.

Mema wɔn a wɔhyɛ mo so no awe wɔn ankasa honam;
    wɔn mogya bɛbo wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔanom nsã.
  Afei adasamma nyinaa bɛhunu
    sɛ me, Awurade, me ne wʼAgyenkwa no,
    mo Gyefoɔ, Yakob Otumfoɔ No.”

Mɛto dwom ama me dɔfo
    ɛdwom a ɛfa ne bobe turo ho:
  Na me dɔfo wɔ bobe turo bi
    wɔ asasebereɛ bi a ɛda bepɔ ani.

Ɔfuntum asase no yiyii mu aboɔ,
    na ɔduaa bobe a ɛyɛ papa wɔ so.
  Ɔsii ɔwɛn aban wɔ mfimfini
    na ɔtuu nsakyimena nso.
  Afei, ɔhwɛɛ anim sɛ ɔbɛtwa bobe aba pa,
    nanso ɛsoo aba bɔne.

“Afei, mo a motete Yerusalem ne Yuda mmarima,
    mommu me ne me bobe turo ntam atɛn.

Ɛdeɛn bio na anka ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ ma me bobe turo
    boro deɛ mayɛ yi so?
  Ɛberɛ a merehwɛ anim sɛ menya bobe a ɛyɛ no
    adɛn enti na ɛsoo aba bɔne?

Afei, mɛka
    deɛ merebɛyɛ me bobefuo no akyerɛ wo:
  Mɛyi ɛho ban no afiri hɔ,
    na wɔbɛsɛe no;
  mɛbubu ɛho fasuo,
    na wɔbɛtiatia so.

Mɛma ayɛ asase a ɛda mpan
    a worenyiyi mu na wɔnyɛ so adwuma,
    ɔhwerɛm ne nkasɛɛ bɛnyini wɔ so.
  Mɛhyɛ omununkum
    na wantɔ nsuo angu so.”

Asafo Awurade bobe turo no
    yɛ Israel fie,
  na Yuda mmarima yɛ turo a nʼani gye ho.
  Ɔpɛɛ atɛn tenenee nanso ɔhunuu mogyahwiegu;
    ɔpɛɛ tenenee nanso ɔtee mmɔborɔ su.

Nnome nka mo a mode efie ka efie ho
    na mogyegye mfuo bobɔ soɔ
  kɔsi sɛ asase no bɛsa
    na ɛka mo nko ara wɔ asase no so.

Asafo Awurade apae mu aka ama mate:
  “Nokorɛm afie akɛseɛ no bɛda mpan,
    na mmorɔsan fɛfɛ no, obiara rentena mu.

Bobefuo kɛseɛ pa ara no
    nsã kakra bi na ɛbɛfiri mu.
  Aba lita aduonu baako a wɔdua no
    wɔbɛnya so lita aduonu mmienu pɛ.”

Wɔnnue, wɔn a wɔsɔre anɔpahema
    kɔhwehwɛ wɔn nsã akyiri kwan,
  wɔn a wɔsiri pɛ
    kɔsi sɛ nsã bɛbo wɔn.

Wɔbɔ sankuten ne bɛnta wɔ wɔn apontoɔ ase,
    akasaeɛ, ne atɛntɛbɛn ne nsã,
  nanso wɔtwiri deɛ Awurade ayɛ,
    na wɔmmu ne nsa ano adwuma.

Ɛno enti, me nkurɔfoɔ bɛkɔ nnommumfa mu,
    ɛfiri sɛ, wɔnni nteaseɛ;
  ɛkɔm bɛkum wɔn mu atitire
    na osukɔm bɛtware wɔn mu bebree.

Enti, damena akɔnnɔ yɛ kɛseɛ
    na ɔbue nʼanom bayaa;
  na emu na atitire ne ɛdɔm no bɛkɔ
    wɔne wɔn a wɔsa na wɔgye wɔn ani.

Enti, wɔbɛbrɛ onipa ase
    na wama adasamma aboto.
    Wɔbɛbrɛ ɔhantanni ase,

nanso Asafo Awurade atɛntenenee bɛpagya no,
    na Kronkron Onyankopɔn de ne tenenee bɛda ne ho adi sɛ Ɔkronkronni.

Afei nnwan bɛkɔ adidi te sɛ deɛ wɔwɔ wɔn adidibea;
    nnwammaa bɛdidi wɔ asikafoɔ amanfo so.

Monnue, mo a mode nnaadaa nhoma twetwe bɔne,
    na mode nteaseɛnam ntampehoma twetwe amumuyɛ.

Monnue, mo a moka sɛ, “Onyankopɔn nyɛ ntɛm,
    ɔnyɛ nʼadwuma ntɛm
  sɛdeɛ yɛbɛhunu.
    Ma ɛmmɛn,
  Israel Ɔkronkronni no nhyehyɛeɛ no mmra,
    sɛdeɛ yɛbɛhunu.”

Monnue, mo a mofrɛ bɔne sɛ papa
    na papa nso sɛ bɔne,
  mo a mode esum si hann anan mu
    na hann si esum anan mu,
  mo a mofrɛ nwononwono sɛ dɛɛdɛ
    ne dɛɛdɛ sɛ nwononwono.

Monnue, mo a mobu mo ho anyansafoɔ, mo ankasa ani so
    ne anitefoɔ mo ankasa ani so.

Monnue mo a wɔfrɛ mo akatakyie wɔ nsanom mu
    ne ahoɔdenfoɔ wɔ nsã afrafra mu.

Mo a mogye adanmudeɛ, na mo gyae deɛ ɔdi fɔ
    na mo bu deɛ ɔdi bem no fɔ.

Enti, sɛdeɛ egyadɛreɛ hye wira dwaneeɛ
    na ɛserɛ a awo yera wɔ ogyaframa mu no,
  saa ara na mo nhini bɛporɔ,
    na mo nhwiren nso atu akɔ sɛ mfuturo;
  ɛfiri sɛ moapo Asafo Awurade mmara
    na moatwiri Israel Kronkronni no asɛm.

Enti Awurade abufuo aba ne nkurɔfoɔ so,
    wapagya ne nsa na ɔde rebɔ wɔn ahwe fam.
  Mmepɔ no woso,
    na afunu ayɛ sɛ mmɔntene so wira.
    
  Nanso yei nyinaa akyi, ne bo nnwoeɛ,
    na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.

Ɔpagya frankaa ma akyirikyiri aman,
    ɔhyɛne abɛn de frɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ asase ano.
  Wɔn na wɔreba no,
    ɔherɛ so ne ntɛm so!

Wɔn mu biara mmrɛ na ɔnsunti,
    obiara ntɔ nko na ɔnna;
  abɔsoɔ biara mu rengo wɔ asene mu
    na mpaboa ahoma biara nso rente.

Wɔn agyan ano yɛ nnam,
    na wɔn tadua nyinaa ayɛ krado;
  wɔn apɔnkɔ ntɔte te sɛ twerɛboɔ,
    wɔn nteaseɛnam ntwahonan te sɛ twahoframa.

Wɔn mmobɔmu te sɛ gyata deɛ,
    na wɔbobɔm sɛ gyata mma;
  wɔpɔso kyere wɔn hanam
    na wɔde no kɔ a ɔgyefoɔ biara nni hɔ.

Ɛda no wɔbɛbobɔ mu agu ne so
    sɛdeɛ ɛpo woro soɔ.
  Na sɛ obi hwɛ asase no a,
    ɔbɛhunu esum kabisii ne ahohiahia;
    omununkum bɛma hann aduru sum.

Sei na Awurade seɛ:
  “Wo maame awaregyaeɛ ho adansedie nwoma
    a megyinaa so gyaa no ɛkwan no wɔ he?
  Anaa sɛ mʼadefirifoɔ mu hwan
    na metɔn wo maa noɔ?
  Wo bɔne enti na wɔtɔn wo;
    Wʼamumuyɛ enti na wɔpamoo wo maame.

Mebaeɛ no, adɛn enti na na obiara nni hɔ?
    Mefrɛeɛ no, adɛn enti na obiara annye soɔ?
  Na me nsa yɛ tia dodo sɛ ɛbɛgye wo anaa?
    Menni ahoɔden a mede bɛgye wo anaa?
  Mede mʼanimka kakra bi ma ɛpo mu nsuo we,
    medane nsubɔntene anweatam
  emu mpataa porɔ ɛsiane nsuo a wɔnnya enti
    na osukɔm kumm wɔn.

Mede esum fira ɔsoro
    na mema ayitoma yɛ ne nkataho.”

Asafo Awurade ama me nkyerɛkyerɛ tɛkrɛma
    sɛ ɛnka asɛm a ɛhyɛ ɔbrɛfoɔ den.
  Ɔnyane me anɔpa biara,
    na ɔbue mʼaso ma metie sɛ obi a ɔregye nkyerɛkyerɛ.

Mede mʼakyi maa wɔn a wɔboro me,
    na mede mʼafono maa wɔn a wɔtutu mʼabɔgyesɛ.
  Mamfa mʼanim ansie wɔn
    fɛdie ne ntasuteɛ ho.

Esiane sɛ, Asafo Awurade boa me enti,
    wɔrengu mʼanim ase.
  Enti na mayɛ mʼanim sɛ twerɛboɔ,
    na menim sɛ mʼanim rengu ase.

Deɛ ɔbu me bem no abɛn.
    Enti hwan na ɔbɛbɔ me kwaadu?
    Ɔmmra na yɛnhyia mu!
  Hwan na ɔbɔ me soboɔ?
    Ma ɔnka nsi mʼanim!

Asafo Awurade na ɔboa me.
    Hwan ne deɛ ɔbɛbu me fɔ?
  Wɔn nyinaa bɛtete sɛ atadeɛ;
    nnweweboaa bɛwe wɔn.

Mo mu hwan na ɔsuro Awurade,
    na ɔdi ne ɔsomfoɔ asɛm so?
  Ma deɛ ɔnam esum mu,
    deɛ ɔnni hann no,
  ɔnnye Awurade din nni
    na ɔmfa ne ho nto ne Onyankopɔn so.

Na afei, monhwɛ yie, mo a monante
    mo ankasa hann mu,
  mo a mode ogya a mo ankasa asɔ ka mo ho hye,
  Yei ne deɛ mobɛnya afiri me nsa mu;
    mobɛhwe ase adeda fam wɔ ɔyea mu.

Monhwɛ Abraham mo agya,
    ne Sara a ɔwoo mo no.
  Ɛberɛ a mefrɛɛ no no, na ɔyɛ ɔbaakofoɔ,
    na mehyiraa no maa nʼase trɛeɛ.

Awurade bɛkyekye Sion werɛ ampa ara
    na ne yam bɛhyehye no wɔ ne mmubuiɛ no ho;
  ɔbɛyɛ nʼanweatam ahodoɔ sɛ Eden,
    nʼasase a ada mpan bɛyɛ sɛ Awurade turo.
  Wɔbɛhunu anigyeɛ ne ahosɛpɛ,
    aseda ne nnwontoɔ wɔ ne mu.

Me tenenee reba ntɛm so,
    me nkwagyeɛ nam ɛkwan so,
    na mʼabasa de atɛntenenee bɛbrɛ aman no.
  Nsupɔ no bɛhwehwɛ me
    na wɔde anidasoɔ bɛtwɛn mʼabasa.

Mompagya mo ani nhwɛ ɔsorosoro,
    monhwɛ asase wɔ fam;
  ɔsorosoro bɛtu ayera sɛ wisie
    na asase bɛtete sɛ atadeɛ
    na wɔn a wɔte so bɛwuwu sɛ nwansena.
  Nanso me nkwagyeɛ bɛtena hɔ daa,
    me tenenee to rentwa da.

“Montie me, mo a monim deɛ ɛteneɛ,
    mo a me mmara wɔ mo akoma mu:
  Monnsuro nnipa animka
    anaa momma wɔn ahohora ntu mo bo.

Na nweweboa bɛwe wɔn te sɛ deɛ wɔwe atadeɛ;
    ɔsonsono bɛsɛe wɔn te sɛ deɛ wɔsɛe kuntu.
  Nanso me tenenee bɛtena hɔ daa
    me nkwagyeɛ bɛfiri awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.”

Nyane, nyane! Ao Awurade basa
    hyɛ ahoɔden aduradeɛ;
  nyane te sɛ nna a atwam no,
    te sɛ tete awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu no.
  Ɛnyɛ wo na wotwitwaa Rahab mu asinasini no,
    na wohwiree asuboa kɛseɛ no mu no?

Ɛnyɛ wo na womaa ɛpo weeɛ,
    nsubunu mu nsuo no,
  deɛ ɔpaee ɛkwan wɔ ɛpo bunu mu no
    sɛdeɛ wɔn a wɔagye wɔn no bɛtumi atwa?

Wɔn a Awurade apata ama wɔn bɛsane aba.
    Wɔde nnwontoɔ bɛhyɛne Sion;
    anigyeɛ a ɛnsa da bɛyɛ wɔn abotire,
  anigyeɛ ne ahosɛpɛ bɛboro wɔn so,
    awerɛhoɔ ne apinisie bɛtu ayera.

“Me, me ara, mene wo werɛ kyekyefoɔ.
    Hwan ne wo a wosuro ɔdasani,
    nnipa mma a wɔyɛ ɛserɛ yi.

Na wo werɛ afiri Awurade, wo yɛfoɔ,
    deɛ ɔtrɛɛ ɔsorosoro mu
    na ɔhyɛɛ asase ase no?
  Wobɛkɔ so ara asuro ɔhyɛsoni no abufuo?
    Wobɛkɔ so ara asuro deɛ ɔde ɔsɛeɛ asi nʼani so no anaa?
  Na ɔhyɛsoni no abufuo wɔ he?

Na mene Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn
    deɛ ɔhwanyane ɛpo, ma nʼasorɔkye woro so.
    Asafo Awurade, ne ne din.

Mede me nsɛm ahyɛ wʼanomu,
    na mede me nsa ase nwunu akata wo so.
  Me a mede ɔsorosoro sii hɔ
    na mehyɛɛ asase ase
  na meka kyerɛ Sion sɛ, ‘Moyɛ me nkurɔfoɔ.’ ”

Nyane, nyane!
    Sɔre, Ao, Yerusalem!
  Wo a wanom afiri Awurade nsam
    nʼabufuo kuruwa no,
  wo a wanom apɔɔdɔ mu nsã atu puo
    deɛ ɛma nnipa tɔ ntintan no.

Wo mma a wowoo wɔn nyinaa mu
    obiara nni hɔ a ɔkyerɛ wo ɛkwan;
  mmammarima a wotetee wɔn nyinaa mu
    obiara nni hɔ a ɔsɔ wo nsa mu.

Saa ɔhaw prenu yi aba wo so,
    hwan na ɔbɛkyekye wo werɛ?
  Mmubuiɛ ne ɔsɛeɛ, ɛkɔm ne akofena,
    hwan na ɔbɛhyɛ wo den?

Wo mma atotɔ baha;
    wɔdeda mmɔntene so baabiara,
    te sɛ ɔtwe a afidie ayi no.
  Awurade abufuo aba wɔn so
    wo Onyankopɔn animka no.

Enti tie yei, wo a worehunu amaneɛ
    waboro, na nso ɛnyɛ nsã na aboro woɔ.

Yei ne deɛ Otumfoɔ Awurade,
    wo Onyankopɔn a ɔbɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ ho ban seɛ:
  “Hwɛ, magye afiri wo nsa mu
    kuruwa a ɛma wotɔɔ ntintan no
  kuruwa a ɛyɛ mʼabufuo pɔɔdɔ no,
    worennom bio.

Mede bɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔha mo no nsa mu,
    wɔn a wɔka kyerɛɛ mo sɛ,
    ‘Butu fam na yɛnnante wo so.’
  Na wode wʼakyi yɛɛ fam
    te sɛ abɔntene a wɔnante so.”

Nyane, nyane, Ao Sion,
    hyɛ ahoɔden aduradeɛ no.
  Hyɛ wo ntadeɛ fɛfɛ no
    Ao, Yerusalem kuropɔn kronkron no.
  Momonotofoɔ ne wɔn a wɔn ho agu fi
    renwura wʼapono mu bio.

Poroporo wo ho mfuturo.
    Sɔre, tena ahennwa so, Ao, Yerusalem.
  Yiyi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no firi wo kɔn mu,
    Ao, Ɔbabaa Sion a wɔafa wo nnomum.

Na yei ne deɛ Awurade seɛ:
  “Wɔantɔn wo annye hwee,
    na ɛnyɛ sika na wɔde bɛgye wo.”

“Na seesei, ɛdeɛn na mehunu yi?” Sei na Awurade seɛ.
    “Wɔafa me nkurɔfoɔ kɔ kwa,
  na wɔn sodifoɔ di fɛw,”
    Awurade na ɔseɛ.
  “Ɛda mu no nyinaa
    wɔkɔ so gu me din ho fi.

Enti me nkurɔfoɔ bɛhunu me din;
    enti ɛda no wɔbɛhunu sɛ
  ɛyɛ me na mehyɛɛ ho nkɔm.
    Aane, ɛyɛ me.”

Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn a wɔde asɛmpa no reba no
    anammɔn yɛ fɛ wɔ mmepɔ no so,
  wɔn a wɔpae mu ka asomdwoesɛm,
    wɔn a wɔde nsɛmmɔdɛ ba,
  wɔn a wɔpae mu ka nkwagyeɛ ho asɛm
    na wɔka kyerɛ Sion sɛ,
    “Mo Onyankopɔn di ɔhene.”

Montie! Mo awɛmfoɔ ma wɔn nne so;
    wɔbɔ mu de anigye team.
  Sɛ Awurade sane ba Sion a,
    wɔde wɔn ani bɛhunu.

Mommɔ mu nto anigye nnwom,
    mo Yerusalem mmubuiɛ,
  ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade akyekye ne nkurɔfoɔ werɛ;
    wagye Yerusalem.

Awurade bɛyi ne basa kronkron no ho
    wɔ amanaman nyinaa anim
  na asase ano nyinaa bɛhunu yɛn Onyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ.

Monkɔ. Momfiri hɔ nkɔ!
    Mommfa mo ho nka biribiara a ɛho nteɛ.
  Mommfiri ho na mo ho nte,
    mo a mokurakura Awurade nkuruwa.

Monntutu mmirika mfiri ha
    anaa monnwane;
  ɛfiri sɛ Awurade bɛdi mo anim,
    Israel Onyankopɔn bɛbɔ mo kyidɔm.

Hwɛ, me ɔsomfoɔ bɛdi yie
    wɔbɛpagya no ayɛ no kɛseɛ.

Dodoɔ a wɔhunuu no ho dwirii wɔn.
    Ɛfiri sɛ wɔsɛee nʼanim a ansɛ onipa biara deɛ
    na ne bɔberɛ sɛeɛ a ɛnsɛ ɔdasani deɛ.

Saa ara na ɔbɛma aman bebree ho adwiri wɔn
    na ahemfo bɛmuamua wɔn ano, ne enti.
  Wɔn a wɔnkaa ne ho asɛm nkyerɛɛ wɔn no bɛhunu,
    na wɔn a wɔnteeɛ no nso bɛte aseɛ.

Hwan na wagye yɛn asɛnka no adie,
    na Awurade abasa no, hwan so na ada adie?

Ɔnyinii wɔ nʼanim te sɛ dua mono ketewa bi,
    te sɛ nhini a ɛfiri asase wesee mu.
  Ɔnni ahoɔfɛ anaa animuonyam a ɛbɛtwetwe yɛn akɔ ne nkyɛn.
    Na biribiara nni ne ho ɛbɛma yɛn ani agye ne ho.

Nnipa bɔɔ no ahohora na wɔpoo no,
    Ɔwerɛhoni a ɔnim ɔyea.
  Yɛdanee yɛn ani a yɛanhwɛ no mpo;
    wɔbuu no animtiaa na yɛn nso, yɛammu no.

Ampa ara ɔfaa yɛn mmerɛyɛ,
    na ɔsoaa yɛn awerɛhoɔ,
  nanso yɛbuu no sɛ Onyankopɔn na watwe nʼaso.
    Yebuu no sɛ Onyankopɔn na wabɔ no na wadwerɛ no.

Nanso, yɛn mmarato enti na wɔpiraa noɔ,
    yɛn amumuyɛ enti na wɔdwerɛɛ no;
  asotwe a ɛde asomdwoeɛ brɛɛ yɛn no daa no so,
    na nʼapirakuro mu na yɛnya ayaresa.

Yɛn nyinaa ayera yera te sɛ nnwan,
    yɛn mu biara afa ne kwan;
  na Awurade de yɛn nyinaa
    amumuyɛ asoa.

Wɔhyɛɛ no so, yɛɛ no aniɛyaa,
    nanso wammue nʼano;
  wɔde no kɔɔeɛ te sɛ odwammaa a wɔrekɔku no.
    Sɛdeɛ odwammaa yɛ dinn wɔ ne nwitwitwafoɔ anim no,
    saa ara na wammue nʼano.

Wɔnam nhyɛsoɔ ne atemmuo so faa no kɔɔeɛ.
    Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka nʼasefoɔ ho asɛm?
  Ɛfiri sɛ wɔyii no firii asase yi so;
    me nkurɔfoɔ mmarato enti, wɔtwee nʼaso.

Wɔyɛɛ ne damena wɔ abɔnefoɔ mu,
    na ne wuo mu, wɔde no too adefoɔ mu
  ɛwom sɛ wanyɛ akakabensɛm biara,
    na obiara ante atorɔsɛm biara amfiri nʼano.

Nanso ɛyɛɛ Awurade pɛ sɛ ɔbɛdwerɛ no ama no ahunu amane.
    Mpo ɔde ne nkwa ayɛ afɔdie afɔrebɔdeɛ.
  Ɔbɛhunu nʼasefoɔ na ne nna bɛware,
    na Awurade pɛ bɛkɔ so wɔ ne nsam.

Ne kra amanehunu akyi,
    ɔbɛhunu nkwa hann, na ne bo atɔ ne yam;
  na ne suahunu mu, me ɔsomfoɔ teneneeni no bɛbu bebree bem,
    na wasoa wɔn amumuyɛ.

Enti mɛma no kyɛfa wɔ akɛsefoɔ mu,
    na ɔne ahoɔdenfoɔ bɛkyɛ asadeɛ
  ɛfiri sɛ ɔde ne nkwa too hɔ maa owuo,
    na wɔkan no fraa mmaratofoɔ.
  Ɔsoaa nnipa bebree bɔne,
    na ɔdi maa mmaratofoɔ.

“To dwom, Ao, ɔbonini, di ahurisie,
    wo a wonnwoo da;
  ma wo nne so na team,
    wo a awoɔ nkaa wo da;
  ɛfiri sɛ ɔbaa a woannya awoɔ da no mma
    adɔɔso sene deɛ ɔwɔ kunu,”
    Awurade na ɔseɛ.

“Nsuro. Wʼanim rengu ase.
    Nsuro aniwuo. Wɔremmrɛ wo ase.
  Wo werɛ bɛfiri wo mmabunu mu aniwuo
    na wo kunayɛ mu ahohora nso, worenkae bio.

Na wo Bɔfoɔ yɛ wo kunu
    Asafo Awurade ne ne din,
  Israel Ɔkronkronni no yɛ wo Gyefoɔ.
    Wɔfrɛ no asase nyinaa so Onyankopɔn.

Awurade bɛsane afrɛ wo
    te sɛ ɔyere a woagyaa no na ɔdi yea wɔ nʼakoma mu,
  ɔyere a ɔwaree mmabaawaberɛ mu
    na wogyaa no mpofirim,” wo Onyankopɔn na ɔseɛ.

“Megyaa wo berɛ tiawa bi mu,
    nanso mefiri ayamhyehyeɛ a emu dɔ mu bɛsane de wo aba.

Abufuo mmorosoɔ mu,
    mede mʼani hintaa wo mmerɛ tiawa bi,
  nanso mʼayamyɛ a ɛnsa da enti,
    mɛhunu wo mmɔbɔ,”
    deɛ Awurade, wo Gyefoɔ seɛ nie.

“Yei te sɛ Noa mmerɛ so a mekaa ntam sɛ
    meremma nsuyire nkata asase ani bio.
  Enti afei maka ntam sɛ meremma mebo mfu wo bio,
    na merenka wʼanim bio.

Sɛ mmepɔ woso,
    na nkokoɔ tutu a,
  me dɔ a ɛnsa da a mewɔ ma wo no renhinhim
    na mʼasomdwoeɛ apam no rentwam,”
    sei na Awurade a ɔwɔ ahummɔborɔ ma mo no seɛ.

“Ao, kuropɔn a ahum abubu wo na wɔnkyekyee wo werɛ,
    mede aboɔ anintɔnka bɛsiesie wo,
    na mede aboɔdemmoɔ ayɛ wo fapem.

Mede bogyaboɔ bɛto wʼabantifi afasuo,
    na mede abohemaa a ɛhyerɛn ayɛ wʼapono,
    na mede aboɔdemmoɔ ayɛ wʼafasuo nyinaa.

Awurade bɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo mmammarima nyinaa,
    na wo mma asomdwoeɛ bɛdɔɔso.

Wobɛtim wɔ tenenee mu:
  Wo ne nhyɛsotrasoɔ ntam kwan bɛware;
    worensuro biribiara.
  Ahupoo bɛkɔ akyirikyiri,
    na ɛremmɛn wo.

Sɛ obi to hyɛ wo so a, na ɛmfiri me;
    na deɛ ɔto hyɛ wo so no de ne ho bɛma wo.

“Hwɛ, ɛyɛ me na mebɔɔ ɔtomfoɔ
    a ɔfite gyasramma mu ma ɛdɛre
    na ɔde ahoɔden bɔ akodeɛ a ɛfata ne dwumadie.
  Na ɛyɛ me na mabɔ ɔsɛefoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛsɛe adeɛ;

akodeɛ biara a wɔabɔ atia wo no rennyina
    na tɛkrɛma biara a ɛbɛbɔ wo soboɔ no, wobɛbɔ agu.
  Yei ne Awurade nkoa agyapadeɛ
    ne wɔn bembuo a ɛfiri me,”
    Awurade na ɔseɛ.

“Mommra, mo a osukɔm de mo nyinaa,
    mommra nsuo no ho;
  na mo a monni sika,
    mommra mmɛtɔ na monni!
  Mommra mmɛtɔ nsã ne nufosuo
    a monntua hwee.

Adɛn enti na mosɛe sika wɔ deɛ ɛnyɛ aduane ho
    ne mo ahoɔden wɔ deɛ ɛmmee ho?
  Montie, montie me na monni deɛ ɛyɛ,
    na mo kra ani bɛgye nnepa a ɛwɔ akatua pa ho.

Monyɛ aso, na mommra me nkyɛn;
    montie me, na mo kra anya nkwa.
  Me ne mo bɛyɛ apam a ɛte hɔ daa,
    me dɔ a ɛtoɔ ntwa da a mede hyɛɛ Dawid bɔ no.

Hwɛ, mede no ayɛ adansedie ama nnipa no,
    wɔn ɔkandifoɔ ne ɔsahene.

Ampa ara mobɛfrɛ aman a monnim wɔn,
    na aman a wonnim mo no bɛyɛ ntɛm aba mo nkyɛn,
  Awurade, mo Onyankopɔn enti,
    Israel Ɔkronkronni no,
    ɛfiri sɛ wahyɛ mo animuonyam.”

Monhwehwɛ Awurade ɛberɛ a mobɛhunu no.
    Momfrɛ no ɛberɛ a ɔbɛn.

Ma omumuyɛfoɔ ntwe ne ho mfiri nʼakwan ho
    na ɔbɔnefoɔ nso mfiri ne nsusuiɛ ho.
  Ma ɔnnane nkɔ Awurade nkyɛn, na ɔbɛhunu no mmɔbɔ,
    ɔnnane nkɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn nkyɛn, na ɔde ne ho bɛkyɛ no.

“Na mʼadwene nnyɛ mo adwene,
    na mo akwan nso nnyɛ mʼakwan,”
    sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie.

“Sɛdeɛ ɔsoro korɔn sene asase no,
    saa ara na mʼakwan korɔn sene mo akwan,
    na mʼadwene nso korɔn sene mo adwene.

Osuo ne sukyerɛmma
    tɔ firi soro gu fam,
  na ɛnsane nkɔ hɔ bio
    gye sɛ afɔ asase
  ama afifideɛ ɛgu nhwiren,
    sɛdeɛ ɛbɛso aba ama ogufoɔ na aduane nso aba ama deɛ ɔdie.

Saa ara na mʼasɛm a ɛfiri mʼanum teɛ:
    Ɛrensane mma me nkyɛn kwa.
  Mmom ɛbɛyɛ deɛ mepɛ
    na awie botaeɛ a ɛno enti mesomaa no.

Mode ahosɛpɛ bɛpue
    na wɔagya mo kwan asomdwoeɛ mu;
  mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ
    bɛto nnwom wɔ mo anim,
  na mfuo so nnua nyinaa
    bɛbɔ wɔn nsam.

Nkyɛkyerɛ ananmu, pepeaa bɛfifiri,
    na nnɛnkyɛnse ananmu, ohwam dua bɛfifiri.
  Yei bɛyɛ deɛ ɛhyɛ Awurade animuonyam,
    ɛbɛyɛ daapem nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ,
    a ɛrentwam da.”

Yei ne deɛ Awurade seɛ:
  “Monkɔ so mmu atɛntenenee
    na monyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ,
  ɛfiri sɛ me nkwagyeɛ abɛn
    na ɛrenkyɛre me tenenee bɛda adi.

Nhyira nka onipa a ɔyɛ yeinom,
    onipa a ɔkura mu denden:
  deɛ ɔkae Homeda na ɔyɛ no kronkron,
    na ɔkame ne ho firi bɔneyɛ ho.”

Mma ɔnanani a ɔde ne ho ama Awurade nka sɛ,
    “Ampa ara Awurade renkane me mfra ne nkurɔfoɔ mu.”
  Na opiani biara nso nwiinwii sɛ,
    “Meyɛ duawuiɛ.”

Sei na Awurade seɛ,
    “Apiafoɔ a wɔkae me home nna,
  wɔn a wɔyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ mʼani
    na wɔkura mʼapam mu denden,

mɛma wɔn, wɔ mʼasɔredan ne ɛho afasuo no mu,
    nkaedeɛ ne edin a
    ɛkyɛn mmammarima ne mmammaa;
  mɛma wɔn edin a ɛbɛtena hɔ afebɔɔ,
    edin a ɛrentwam.

Na ananafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ama Awurade
    sɛ wɔbɛsom no,
  sɛ wɔbɛdɔ Awurade din,
    na wɔasɔre no,
  wɔn a wɔkae Homeda na wɔyɛ no kronkron nyinaa,
    na wɔkura mʼapam mu denden;

yeinom na mede wɔn bɛba me bepɔ kronkron no so
    na mama wɔn anigyeɛ wɔ me mpaeɛbɔ efie.
  Wɔn ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ ne afɔrebɔ ahodoɔ no,
    mɛgye wɔ mʼafɔrebukyia so;
  na wɔbɛfrɛ me fie beaeɛ a
    aman nyinaa bɔ mpaeɛ.”

Otumfoɔ Awurade,
    deɛ ɔboaboa Israel atukɔfoɔ ano no ka sɛ:
  “Mɛkɔ so aboaboa afoforɔ ano aka wɔn ho
    aka wɔn a maboa wɔn ano dada no ho.”

Mommra, mo wiram mmoadoma nyinaa,
    mommɛdidi, mo kwaeɛm mmoa nyinaa!

“Mommra,” obiara team sɛ, “momma me nsã!
    Momma yɛnnom nsaden mmoro!
  Na ɔkyena bɛyɛ sɛ ɛnnɛ,
    ebia ɛbɛsene ɛnnɛ koraa.”

Ateneneefoɔ wu,
    na obiara nnwene ho wɔ nʼakoma mu;
  wɔfa Nyamesurofoɔ kɔ,
    na obiara nte aseɛ
  sɛ wɔfa teneneefoɔ kɔ
    sɛdeɛ wɔbɛyi wɔn afiri bɔne mu.

“Nanso, mo, mommra ha, mo ɔbayifoɔ mmammarima,
    mo awaresɛefoɔ ne mmaa adwamanfoɔ mma!

Hwan na moresere no?
    Hwan na moredi ne ho fɛ
    na morebɔ no adapaa yi?
  Monnyɛ atuatefoɔ fekuo
    ne atorofoɔ asefoɔ anaa?

Mode ɔpɛ mmorosoɔ bɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ adum mu
    ne dua biara ase;
  mode mo mma bɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ mmɔnhwa a emu dɔ mu
    ne abotan mpaapaeɛ ase.

Anyame a wɔyɛ aboɔ tromtrom, a ɛwɔ mmɔnhwa a emu dɔ mu no,
    wɔyɛ mo kyɛfa. Wɔn na mopɛ.
  Aane, moahwie nsã afɔrebɔdeɛ agu wɔn so
    na mode aduane afɔrebɔdeɛ ama wɔn.
    Yeinom nyinaa akyi, mengo me nsam anaa?

Moasiesie mo daberɛ wɔ kokoɔ a ɛkorɔn so;
    ɛhɔ na mokɔ kɔbɔ afɔdeɛ.

Mo apono ne aponnwa akyi
    na mo de mo abosonsom nsɛsodeɛ asisi.
  Mofirii mʼakyi kɔyii mo mpa so ntoma,
    mokɔdaa so na motrɛɛ mu;
  mo ne wɔn a modɔ wɔn mpa yɛɛ apam,
    na mohwɛɛ wɔn adagya mu.

Mode ngo kɔɔ Molek nkyɛn
    na momaa mo nnuhwam dɔɔso.
  Mosomaa mo ananmusifoɔ kɔɔ akyirikyiri;
    mo siane kɔɔ ɛda mu ankasa!

Mo nneyɛɛ maa mo brɛeɛ,
    nanso moanka da sɛ, ‘Ɛho nni mfasoɔ.’
  Monyaa akɔnnɔ ahoɔden foforɔ,
    enti mokɔɔ so ara yɛɛ deɛ mopɛ.

“Hwan na wama mo akoma atu na wabɔ mo hu sei
    a enti moanni me nokorɛ,
  na moankae me
    anaa moannwene yei ho wɔ mo akoma mu?
  Mayɛ dinn akyɛre no enti
    na monnsuro me anaa?

Mɛda mo tenenee ne mo nnwuma adi,
    na ɛho remma mo mfasoɔ.

Sɛ moteam pɛ mmoa a,
    momma mo ahoni a moaboa ano no nnye mo!
  Mframa bɛbɔ wɔn nyinaa akɔ,
    ahome kɛkɛ bɛhwete wɔn.
  Nanso onipa a ɔde me yɛ ne dwanekɔbea no
    bɛdi asase no so
    na wafa me bepɔ kronkron no.”

Na wɔbɛka sɛ:
  “Monyɛ, monyɛ. Monsiesie ɛkwan no!
    Monyiyi akwansideɛ mfiri me nkurɔfoɔ akwan mu.”

Na yei ne deɛ ɔkorɔn no,
    deɛ ɔte ase daa a ne din yɛ kronkron no seɛ:
  “Mete beaeɛ a ɛkorɔn na ɛyɛ kronkron,
    me ne deɛ ɔwɔ ahonu na ɔyɛ honhom mu hiani nso te,
  sɛ mɛkanyane honhom mu hiani no honhom,
    na makanyane nʼakoma a abubu no.

Meremmɔ soboɔ afebɔɔ,
    na mebo remfu daa,
  sɛ anyɛ saa a, onipa honhom bɛtɔ piti wɔ mʼanim,
    onipa ahome a me na mabɔ.

Mahunu wɔn nneyɛɛ, nanso mɛsa wɔn yadeɛ.
    Mɛkyerɛ wɔn kwan na makyekye wɔn werɛ,

na mama ayɛyie aba wɔn a wɔredi awerɛhoɔ wɔ Israel ano.
  Asomdwoeɛ, asomdwoeɛ, mmra wɔn a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri ne wɔn a wɔbɛn so,”
    sei na Awurade seɛ. “Na mɛsa wɔn yadeɛ.”

Na amumuyɛfoɔ te sɛ ɛpo a ɛrehuru,
    ɛntumi nyɛ komm,
    nʼasorɔkye yiyi atɛkyɛ ne efi.
“Amumuyɛfoɔ nni asomdwoeɛ.” Sei na me Onyankopɔn seɛ.

“Monteam denden, monnnyae.
    Momma mo nne so sɛ totorobɛnto.
  Mompae mu nka me nkurɔfoɔ atuateɛ nkyerɛ wɔn
    na monka Yakob efie nso nnebɔne nkyerɛ no.

Ɛda biara da wɔhwehwɛ me;
    ayɛ sɛ wɔpere sɛ wɔbɛhunu mʼakwan,
  te sɛ wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ deɛ ɛtene
    na wɔmpoo wɔn Onyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ.
  Wɔbisa me hɔ asɛntenenee
    na ayɛ sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛn wɔn.

Wɔka sɛ, ‘Adɛn enti na yɛadi mmuada
    na woanhunu yi?
  Adɛn enti na yɛabrɛ yɛn ho ase,
    na woanhwɛ yi?’
    
  “Nanso mo abuada da no, moyɛ deɛ mopɛ
    na mosisi mo adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa.

Ntɔkwa ne akasakasa na mode wie mo abuadadie,
    ne akuturuku a mode bobɔ mo ho.
  Morentumi nni mmuada sɛdeɛ moyɛ no ɛnnɛ yi
    na moahwɛ anim sɛ wɔbɛte mo nne wɔ soro.

Yei ne mmuadadie a mepɛ anaa?
    Ɛda koro pɛ a onipa de brɛ ne ho ase no anaa?
  Ɛne sɛ obi si ne tiri ase te sɛ demmire
    na ɔtena ayitoma so ne nsõ mu nko ara anaa?
  Yei na mofrɛ no abuadadie yi,
    ɛda a ɛsɔ Awurade ani yi ni anaa?

“Saa mmuadadie yi na mepɛ:
    sɛ mobɛyiyi ntɛnkyea nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn
  na moasane kɔnnua nhoma,
  sɛ mobɛgyaa wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so
    na moabubu kɔnnua biara.

Ɛsɛ sɛ mo ne wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn kyɛ mo aduane
    na moma ohiani a ɔnenam no baabi tena.
  Sɛ mohunu deɛ ɔda adagya a, momfira no ntoma
    na monnyi mo ani mfiri mo yɔnko onipa so.

Ɛno na mo hann bɛpue te sɛ ahemadakye,
    na mo ayaresa aba ntɛm so;
  afei mo tenenee bɛdi mo anim,
    na Awurade animuonyam bɛbɔ mo kyidɔm.

Afei mobɛfrɛ, na Awurade bɛgye mo so;
    mobɛteam apɛ mmoa, na ɔbɛka sɛ: Me nie.
    
  “Sɛ moyi nhyɛsoɔ kɔnnua,
    nsa a motene wɔ onipa so ne ntwatoso firi hɔ,

na sɛ moha mo ho ma wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn
    na moma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no deɛ ɛhia wɔn a,
  ɛnneɛ mo nkanea bɛhyerɛn wɔ esum mu,
    na mo anadwo bɛyɛ sɛ owigyinaeɛ.

Awurade bɛkyerɛ mo ɛkwan ɛberɛ biara;
    ɔbɛma mo deɛ ɛhia mo wɔ asase wesee so
    na ɔbɛhyɛ mo onipadua den.
  Mobɛyɛ sɛ turo a wɔgugu so nsuo yie,
    sɛ asuwa a emu nsuo nwe da.

Mo nkurɔfoɔ bɛsane asi teteete mmubuiɛ no,
    na wɔato fapem a akyɛre no;
  wɔbɛfrɛ mo Deɛ Ɔsiesie Afasuo a Abubu no,
    Deɛ Ɔsiesie Adan a Abubu.

“Sɛ mohwɛ mo anammɔntuo so yie Homeda
    na moannyɛ deɛ mopɛ wɔ me da kronkron no,
  sɛ mofrɛ Homeda no anigyeɛ da
    na modi Awurade da kronkron no ni
  na moamfa mo ara mo akwan so
    na moanyɛ deɛ mopɛ anaa moanka nsɛmhunu a,

ɛnneɛ mobɛnya anigyeɛ wɔ Awurade mu
    na mɛma mo anante asase no sorɔnsorɔmmea so
  na moato pon wɔ mo agya Yakob agyapadeɛ so.”
    Awurade na aka.

Ampa ara Awurade nsa nyɛ tiaa sɛ ɛrennye nkwa,
    na nʼasom nyɛ den sɛ ɛrente asɛm.

Nanso, mo amumuyɛ na atete
    mo ne mo Onyankopɔn ntam;
  mo bɔne ama nʼanim ahinta mo,
    a enti ɔrente.

Na mogya akeka mo nsa ho,
    afɔdie afɔre mo nsateaa.
  Mo ano akeka atorɔsɛm,
    mo tɛkrɛma de amumuyɛsɛm di nsekuro.

Wɔhwane ananka nkosua
    na wɔnwono ananse ntontan.
  Deɛ ɔdi wɔn nkosua biara bɛwu,
    emu baako nso bɔ a, ɛpae ahuritia.

Wɔn ntontan nyɛ mma aduradeɛ;
    wɔrentumi mfa deɛ wɔyɛ nkata wɔn ho.
  Wɔn nneyɛɛ yɛ nneyɛɛ bɔne,
    na wɔdi akakabensɛm.

Asomdwoeɛ kwan no, wɔnnim;
    atɛntenenee nni wɔn akwan so.
  Wɔadane wɔn akwan nkontonkyi.
    Obiara a ɔnante soɔ no rennya asomdwoeɛ.

Enti atɛntenenee ne yɛn ntam aware,
    na adetenenee mmɛn yɛn.
  Yɛhwehwɛ hann, nanso ne nyinaa yɛ esum;
    deɛ ɛhyerɛn, nanso yɛnam esum kabii mu.

Yɛayɛ te sɛ anifirafoɔ. Yɛkeka afasuo ho
    hwehwɛ kwan te sɛ nnipa a wɔnni ani.
  Owigyinaeɛ no, yɛsuntisunti sɛdeɛ onwunu adwoɔ;
    yɛduru ahoɔdenfoɔ mu a, yɛte sɛ awufoɔ.

Ɛfiri sɛ, yɛn mfomsoɔ adɔɔso wɔ wʼani so,
    na yɛn bɔne di adanseɛ tia yɛn.
  Yɛn mfomsoɔ da yɛn anim daa,
    na yɛgye yɛn amumuyɛ to mu:

atuateɛ ne afatwa a ɛtia Awurade,
    yɛn akyi a yɛdane kyerɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn,
  nhyɛsoɔ ne atuateɛ a yɛfoa soɔ,
    atorɔsɛm a ɛfiri akoma mu a yɛka.

Enti wɔapam atɛntenenee kɔ nʼakyi,
    na adetenenee akɔgyina baabi;
  nokorɛ ahwe ase wɔ mmɔntene so.
    Nokorɛdie ntumi mma mu.

Nokorɛ nni baabiara,
    obiara a ɔtwe ne ho firi bɔne ho no ayɛ ɔtamfoɔ.
    
  Awurade hwɛeɛ na ansɔ nʼani
    sɛ atɛntenenee nni hɔ.

Ohunuu sɛ obiara nni hɔ.
    Ɛyɛɛ no nwanwa sɛ obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛpata;
  enti ɔno ankasa basa dii nkwagyeɛ ho dwuma maa no,
    na ne tenenee wowaa no.

Ɔhyɛɛ tenenee sɛ nkataboɔ,
    ne nkwagyeɛ dadeɛ kyɛ wɔ ne tiri so.
  Ɔhyɛɛ aweretɔ ntadeɛ
    na ɔde mmɔdemmɔ firaa sɛ ntoma.

Ɔbɛgyina deɛ wɔayɛ so
    atua so ka.
  Nʼatamfoɔ bɛnya nʼabufuhyeɛ.
    Wɔn a wɔne no ayɛ dɔm bɛnya so akatua;
    nsupɔ no nso, ɔbɛtua wɔn ka sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ wɔn.

Ɛfiri atɔeɛ fam, nnipa bɛsuro Awurade din
    na ɛfiri apueeɛ wɔde anidie bɛma nʼanimuonyam.
  Na ɔbɛba sɛ nsuo a ayiri tɛnn,
    Awurade ahomeguo de no bɛba.

“Ɔgyefoɔ no bɛba Sion,
    na ɔbɛyi amumuyɛsɛm nyinaa afiri Yakob asefoɔ mu,”
    sei na Awurade seɛ.

“Medeɛ yei yɛ me ne wɔn apam,” sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie. “Me Honhom a ɔwɔ mo so, ne me nsɛm a mede ahyɛ mo anom remfiri mo anom, anaa mo mma, ne mo mma asefoɔ anom, ɛfiri saa ɛberɛ yi kɔsi daa apem,” sei na Awurade seɛ.
Afe a ɔhene Usia wuiɛ mu no, mehunuu Awurade sɛ ɔte ahennwa a, ɛkorɔn na wapagya so na nʼatadeɛ mmuano ayɛ asɔrefie hɔ ma.
Na serafim a wɔn mu biara wɔ ntaban nsia wɔ nʼAtifi. Wɔde ntaban no mmienu kata wɔn anim, na wɔde mmienu nso kata wɔn nan ho ɛnna wɔde mmienu nso tu.
Wɔn nne nnyegyeeɛ maa apono ne aboboano wosooɛ, na wisie yɛɛ asɔrefie hɔ ma.
Meteam kaa sɛ, “Me nnue! Memfata! Meyɛ onipa a mʼano ho nteɛ, na mete nnipa a wɔn ano ho nteɛ mu, Ɔhene, Otumfoɔ Awurade na mʼani ahunu no yi.”
Na serafim no mu baako a ɔkura gyasramma, a ɔde daban kɔfa firii afɔrebukyia no so tu baa me nkyɛn.
Ɔde yei kaa mʼano kaa sɛ, “Hwɛ, yei aka wʼanofafa, wɔayi wʼafɔdie na wɔatua wo bɔne so ka.”

Afei, metee Awurade nne a ɛrebisa sɛ, “Hwan na mensoma no? Na hwan na ɔbɛkɔ ama yɛn?”
    Na mekaa sɛ, “Me nie. Soma me!”

Ɛfiri sɛ mo, moapirim mo akoma;
    moasi mo aso,
    akatakata mo ani.
  Ɛnyɛ saa a, anka mo ani bɛhunu adeɛ,
    na mo akoma ate asɛm ase,
  na moanu mo ho asane aba me nkyɛn, na masa mo yadeɛ.”

Na mekaa sɛ, “Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn, Ao Awurade?”
    Na ɔbuaa sɛ,
  “Ɛnkɔsi sɛ nkuropɔn no bɛyɛ nkurofon
    a nnipa ntete soɔ,
  ɛnkɔsi sɛ afie no bɛyɛ afituo
    na mfuo no asɛe ayɛ pasaa,

ɛnkɔsi sɛ, Awurade bɛpamo obiara akɔ akyirikyiri
    na asase no ada mpan.

Mpo, sɛ nkyɛmu edu mu baako ka asase no so a,
    wɔbɛsɛe no bio.
  Nso sɛdeɛ dupɔn anaa odum
    gya dunsini ɛberɛ a wɔatwa ato fam no,
    saa ara na aba kronkron no bɛyɛ dunsini wɔ asase no so.”

“Sɔre, hyerɛn, na wo hann aba,
    na Awurade animuonyam apue wo so.

Hwɛ, esum akata asase so
    na esum kabii akata aman no so,
  nanso Awurade apue wo so
    na nʼanimuonyam ada adi wɔ wo so.

Amanaman bɛba wo hann no mu,
    na Ahemfo bɛba wo adekyeɛ hann no mo.

“Ma wʼani so na hwɛ wo ho hyia:
    wɔn nyinaa aboa wɔn ho ano reba wo nkyɛn;
  wo mmammarima fifiri akyirikyiri,
    na wɔkura wo mmammaa wɔ abasa so.

Afei wobɛhwɛ na wʼanim ate,
    wʼakoma bɛbɔ na anigyeɛ ahyɛ no ma;
  ahonya a ɛwɔ ɛpo so, wɔde bɛbrɛ wo,
    na amanaman no ahodeɛ nso bɛba wo nkyɛn.

Yoma akuakuo bɛyɛ wʼasase so ma,
    yomaforɔ a wofiri Midian ne Efa.
  Na wɔn a wɔfiri Seba nyinaa bɛba,
    wɔsoso sika kɔkɔɔ ne nnuhwam
    na wɔpae mu ka Awurade ayɛyie.

Wɔbɛboaboa Kedar nnwankuo nyinaa ano abrɛ wo,
    Nebaiot nnwennini bɛsom wo;
  wɔbɛgye wɔn sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ wɔ mʼafɔrebukyia so,
    na mɛhyɛ mʼasɔredan kronkron no animuonyam.

“Hwannom ne yeinom a wɔtu sɛ omununkum,
    te sɛ mmorɔnoma a wɔrekɔ wɔn pirebuo mu yi?

Ampa ara nsupɔ no ani da me so;
    Tarsis ahyɛn na wɔdi anim,
  wɔde wo mmammarima fifiri akyirikyiri reba,
    wɔsoso wɔn dwetɛ ne wɔn sika kɔkɔɔ,
  de rebɛhyɛ Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn animuonyam,
    Israel Kronkronni No,
    ɛfiri sɛ wahyɛ wo animuonyam.

“Ananafoɔ bɛto wʼafasuo no bio,
    na wɔn ahemfo bɛsom wo.
  Ɛwom sɛ mede abufuo asɛe wo deɛ,
    nanso menam adom so bɛhunu wo mmɔbɔ.

Wʼapono ano bɛdeda hɔ ɛberɛ biara,
    wɔrentoto mu awia anaa anadwo,
  sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nkurɔfoɔ de amanaman no ahonya bɛbrɛ wo,
    a wɔn ahemfo di nkonimdie santen no anim.

Na ɔman anaa ahennie a wɔrensom wo no bɛyera,
  wɔbɛsɛe no pasaa.

“Lebanon animuonyam bɛba wo nkyɛn,
    pepeaa, sɛsɛ ne kwabɔhɔrɔ bɛbɔ mu,
  abɛsiesie me kronkronbea hɔ;
    na mɛhyɛ beaeɛ a menan sisi no animuonyam.

Wo nhyɛsofoɔ mmammarima bɛba abɛkoto wo;
    wɔn a wɔbu wo animtia nyinaa bɛkoto wo nan ase
  na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Awurade Kuropɔn,
    Israel Kronkronni, Sion.

“Ɛwom sɛ wɔapa wʼakyi atane wo,
    a obiara ntu kwan mfa wo mu,
  nanso mɛyɛ wo ahohoahoadeɛ a ɛte hɔ daa
    ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa anigyedeɛ.

Wobɛnom amanaman nufosuo no
    na woanum adehyeɛ nufoɔ.
  Afei wobɛhunu sɛ me Awurade, me ne wo Agyenkwa,
    wo gyefoɔ, Yakob Otumfoɔ no.

Mede sikakɔkɔɔ bɛsi kɔbere anan mu abrɛ wo,
    na dwetɛ asi dadeɛ anan mu.
  Mede kɔbere bɛsi dua anan mu abrɛ wo,
    na dadeɛ asi aboɔ anan mu.
  Mede asomdwoeɛ bɛyɛ wo so amrado
    na tenenee ayɛ wo sodifoɔ.

Wɔrente awurukasɛm wɔ wʼasase so bio,
    anaa mmubuiɛ ne ɔsɛeɛ wɔ wʼahyeɛ so.
  Na mmom wobɛfrɛ wʼafasuo sɛ Nkwagyeɛ
    ne wʼapono sɛ Ayɛyie.

Owia renyɛ wo hann adekyeɛ mu bio
    na ɔsrane hann renhyerɛn wo so,
  ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade bɛyɛ wo daapem hann,
    na wo Onyankopɔn bɛyɛ wo animuonyam.

Wʼawia rentɔ bio,
    wo srane rennum bio,
  Awurade bɛyɛ wo daapem hann,
    na wʼawerɛhoɔ nna to bɛtwa.

Na afei wo nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa bɛyɛ teneneefoɔ
    na wɔbɛfa asase no adi so afebɔɔ.
  Wɔyɛ adeɛ a madua na afefɛ
    me nsa ano adwuma a
    ɛbɛda mʼanimuonyam adi.

Mo mu akumaa koraa bɛdɔre ayɛ apem,
    na ketewa no ayɛ ɔman kɛseɛ.
  Mene Awurade;
    na ne berɛ mu, mɛyɛ yei ntɛm so.”

Otumfoɔ Awurade Honhom wɔ me so,
    ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade asra me ngo
    sɛ menka asɛmpa nkyerɛ ahiafoɔ.
  Wasoma me sɛ, menkɔkyekye wɔn a wɔn akoma abubu werɛ,
    sɛ me mpae mu nka ahofadie nkyerɛ nnommumfoɔ
    na wɔnyi nneduafoɔ mfiri esum mu,

sɛ mempae mu nka Awurade adom no ho asɛm,
    ne yɛn Onyankopɔn aweretɔ da.
  Wasoma me sɛ, menkyekye wɔn a wɔdi awerɛhoɔ nyinaa werɛ,

na memma wɔn a wɔdi awerɛhoɔ wɔ Sion no deɛ wɔhia,
  na menhyɛ wɔn ahenkyɛ fɛfɛ
    nsi nsõ anan mu;
  anigyeɛ ngo
    nsi awerɛhoɔdie anan mu,
  ayɛyie atadeɛ
    nsi abasamutuo honhom anan mu.
  Wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn tenenee adum
    deɛ Awurade adua
    de ada nʼanimuonyam adi.

Wɔbɛsi tete mmubuiɛ no bio,
    na wɔasiesie mmeammea a asɛe dadaada no;
  wɔbɛyɛ nkuropɔn a asɛeɛ no foforɔ
    deɛ asɛe awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bebree no.

Ananafoɔ bɛhwɛ mo nnwankuo;
    ahɔhoɔ bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ mo mfuo ne bobeturo mu.

Na wɔbɛfrɛ mo Awurade asɔfoɔ,
    wɔbɛto mo din sɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn asomfoɔ.
  Amanaman no ahonya no na mobɛdi
    na wɔn ahodeɛ na mode bɛhoahoa mo ho.

Wɔn animguaseɛ anan mu
    me nkurɔfoɔ bɛnya animuonyam mmɔho,
  na ahohora anan mu
    wɔbɛsɛpɛ wɔn ho wɔ wɔn adedie mu;
  ne saa enti wɔn asase no so kyɛfa bɛyɛ mmɔho,
    na anigyeɛ a ɛnni awieeɛ bɛyɛ wɔn dea.

“Na me Awurade, mepɛ atɛntenenee.
    Mekyiri korɔno ne nnebɔne.
  Me nokorɛ mu, mɛbɔ wɔn aba so
    na me ne wɔn ayɛ apam a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.

Wɔn asefoɔ bɛgye din wɔ amanaman no mu
    ne wɔn mma wɔ nkurɔfoɔ no mu.
  Wɔn a wɔhunu wɔn nyinaa bɛgye ato mu sɛ
    wɔyɛ nnipa a Awurade ahyira wɔn.”

Awurade mu na me ho sɛpɛ me mmorosoɔ,
    me Onyankopɔn mu na me ɔkra di ahurisie.
  Ɛfiri sɛ, ɔde nkwagyeɛ ntoma afira me
    na ɔde tenenee atadeɛ yuu awura me,
  sɛdeɛ ayeforɔkunu siesie me tiri so sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ,
    ne sɛdeɛ ayɛforɔ de nnwinneɛ hyehyɛ ne ho.

Na sɛdeɛ asase ma afifideɛ pue
    na turo nso ma aba nyini no,
  saa ara na Otumfoɔ Awurade bɛma tenenee ne ayɛyie
    apue wɔ amanaman anim.

Sion enti, merenyɛ komm,
    Yerusalem enti, merenyɛ dinn,
  kɔsi sɛ ne tenenee bɛhyerɛn sɛ adekyeɛ,
    na ne nkwagyeɛ adɛre sɛ ogyatɛn.

Amanaman no bɛhunu wo tenenee,
    na ahemfo nyinaa ahunu wo animuonyam;
  wɔbɛfrɛ wo din foforɔ
    a Awurade de bɛto wo.

Wobɛyɛ animuonyam ahenkyɛ wɔ Awurade nsam,
    ne adehyeɛ abɔtiten wɔ wo Onyankopɔn nsam.

Wɔremfrɛ wo atugya bio,
    anaa wʼasase sɛ amanfo.
  Na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Hefsiba anaa anisɔ Kuropɔn
    ne wʼasase sɛ Beula anaa ɔwarefoɔ
  ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ani bɛgye wo ho,
    na ɔbɛware wʼasase.

Sɛdeɛ aberanteɛ ware ababaawa no,
    saa ara na wo mmammarima bɛware wo;
  sɛdeɛ ayeforɔkunu ani gye nʼayeforɔ ho no,
    saa ara na wo Onyankopɔn ani bɛgye wo ho.

Mede awɛmfoɔ agyinagyina wʼafasuo so Ao, Yerusalem;
    wɔremmua wɔn ano awia anaa anadwo.
  Mo a musu frɛ Awurade no,
    monnhome koraa,

na mommma ɔnnye nʼahome kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛma Yerusalem atim
    na wayɛ no deɛ asase nyinaa bɛkamfo.

Awurade de ne basa nifa aka ntam,
    ne basa a ɛyɛ den no sɛ,
  “Meremfa mo ayuo
    mma mo atamfoɔ sɛ wɔn aduane bio,
  na ananafoɔ rennom nsã foforɔ
    a moabrɛ ho no bio;

wɔn a wɔtwa no na wɔbɛdi
    na wɔakamfo Awurade,
  na wɔn a wɔboaboa bobe ano no bɛnom
    wɔ me kronkronbea adihɔ.”

Momfa mu, momfa kuropɔn apono no mu!
    Monsiesie kwan no mma nkurɔfoɔ no.
  Mompae, mompae kwantempɔn no!
    Monyiyi so aboɔ no.
  Monsi frankaa mma amanaman no.

Awurade abɔ no dawuro
    akɔsi nsase ano sɛ,
  “Monka nkyerɛ Ɔbabaa Sion sɛ,
    ‘Hwɛ, wo Agyenkwa reba!
  Hwɛ nʼakatua ka ne ho,
    na nʼanamuhyɛdeɛ nso ka ne ho.’ ”

Wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn Nnipa Kronkron,
    wɔn a Awurade Agye Wɔn;
  na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Deɛ Wɔrehwehwɛ Nʼakyiri Ɛkwan,
    Kuropɔn a Ɛrenyɛ Afo Bio.

Hwan ni yei a ɔfiri Edom reba,
    deɛ ɔfiri Bosra a nkekaeɛ kɔkɔɔ wɔ nʼatadeɛ mu yi?
  Hwan ne yei a wɔahyehyɛ no gɔsɔɔ yi,
    a ɔde nʼahoɔden kɛseɛ retutu taataa yi?
    
  “Ɛyɛ me a mekasa wɔ tenenee mu
    deɛ ɔtumi gye nkwa.”

Adɛn enti na mo ntadeɛ bere kɔɔ,
    te sɛ obi a ɔretiatia nsakyiamena so deɛ yi?

“Me nko ara atiatia nsakyiamena so,
    na amanaman no mu obiara anka me ho.
  Metiatiaa wɔn so wɔ mʼabufuo mu
    na memiaa wɔn so wɔ mʼabufuhyeɛ mu;
  wɔn mogya bɔ petee me ntadeɛ mu,
    maa nkekaeɛ yɛɛ mʼaduradeɛ nyinaa mu.

Na aweretɔ da wɔ mʼakoma mu
    na me gyeɛ afe no aba.

Mehwɛeɛ, nanso na ɔboafoɔ biara nni hɔ,
    ɛyɛɛ me ahodwirie sɛ obiara ammoa me;
  enti mʼankasa abasa yɛɛ nkwagyeɛ dwuma maa me,
    na mʼabufuo wowaa me.

Mɛka Awurade ayamyɛ ho asɛm,
    ne nneyɛɛ a enti ɔsɛ ayɛyie,
    wɔ deɛ Awurade ayɛ ama yɛn nyinaa ho
  aane, wɔ nneɛma pa bebree a wayɛ
    ama Israel fiefoɔ,
    wɔ nʼayamhyehyeɛ ne ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso no enti.

Wɔn amanehunu nyinaa mu, ɔno nso hunuu amane,
    na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔka no ho no nso gyee wɔn.
  Ne dɔ ne ne mmɔborɔhunu mu, ɔgyee wɔn;
    ɔpagyaa wɔn na ɔsoaa wɔn
    mfeɛ a atwam no nyinaa mu.

Nanso, wɔtee atua
    de hoo ne Honhom Kronkron werɛ.
  Enti ɔbɛyɛɛ wɔn ɔtamfoɔ
    na ɔno ankasa ko tiaa wɔn.

Afei ne nkurɔfoɔ kaee tete nna no,
    Mose ne ne nkurɔfoɔ nna no. Wɔbisaa sɛ,
  ɛhe na deɛ ɔde wɔn faa ɛpo mu no wɔ?
    Deɛ ɔmaa Mose yɛɛ ne nnwan no hwɛfoɔ no.
  Ɛhe na deɛ ɔmaa ne Honhom Kronkron no
    tenaa wɔn mu no wɔ?

Deɛ ɔsomaa nʼanimuonyam basa a ɛwɔ tumi
    sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Mose nsa nifa so,
  deɛ ɔpaee nsuo no mu wɔ wɔn anim,
    de gyee edin maa ne ho afebɔɔ,

deɛ ɔdii wɔn anim faa ebunu mu
    sɛdeɛ ɔpɔnkɔ fa asase tamaa so a
    wɔasunti.

Sɛdeɛ anantwie nante kɔ ɛserɛ so kɔhome no,
    saa ara na Awurade Honhom ma wɔhomeeɛ.
  Sɛdeɛ wokyerɛɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ kwan
    de gyee animuonyam abɔdin maa wo ho nie.

Brɛ wʼani ase hwɛ fam
    firi wʼahennwa a ɛkorɔn na ɛyɛ kronkron na ɛho wɔ nyam no so.
  Mo mmɔdemmɔ ne mo ahoɔden wɔ he?
    Woayi wʼayamhyehyeɛ ne wʼahummɔborɔ afiri yɛn so.

Nanso wo ara wo ne yɛn Agya
    ɛwom sɛ Abraham nnim yɛn
    na Israel nso nnye yɛn nto mu deɛ;
  nanso wo, Ao Awurade, wo ne yɛn Agya,
    ɛfiri tete wo din ne Yɛn Gyefoɔ.

Adɛn, Ao Awurade, na woma yɛn kwati wʼakwan
    na wopirim yɛn akoma enti ɛmma yɛn nni wo ni?
  Sane bra ɛsiane wʼasomfoɔ,
    mmusuakuo a wɔyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ no enti.

Ɛberɛ tiawa bi mu wo nkurɔfoɔ faa wo kronkronbea
    nanso seesei yɛn atamfoɔ atiatia so.

Enti yɛyɛ wo dea firi tete
    nanso wɔn deɛ wonnii wɔn so ɔhene
    na wɔmmɔɔ wo din mfrɛɛ wɔn da.

Ao, sɛ anka wobɛsunsuane ɔsorosoro mu, asiane aba fam a,
    ɛno na anka mmepɔ no ho bɛpopo wɔ wʼanim!

Sɛdeɛ ogya ma mmabaa dɛre
    na ɛma nsuo huru no,
  siane bra fam na ma wʼatamfoɔ nhunu wo din
    na ma amanaman no ho mpopo wɔ wʼanim!

Na ɛberɛ a woyɛɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwanwa a yɛanhwɛ anim no,
    wosiane baa fam na mmepɔ no ho popoo wɔ wʼanim.

Ɛfiri teteete obiara nteeɛ,
    ɛntwaa obiara aso mu,
  ani biara nhunuu Onyankopɔn bi sɛ wo,
    deɛ ɔdi dwuma ma wɔn a wɔtwɛn no.

Woboa wɔn a wɔde anigyeɛ yɛ deɛ ɛtene,
    wɔn a wɔkae wʼakwan.
  Nanso yɛkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne tiaa wo no,
    wo bo fuiɛ.
    Na afei ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woagye yɛn nkwa?

Yɛn nyinaa ayɛ sɛ obi a ne ho nteɛ,
    na yɛn tenenee nneyɛɛ nyinaa te sɛ ntomago fi;
  yɛn nyinaa akusa te sɛ ahahan,
    na yɛn bɔne pra yɛn kɔ te sɛ mframa.

Obiara mmɔ wo din,
    na obiara mpere sɛ ɔbɛso wo mu;
  ɛfiri sɛ wode wʼanim ahinta yɛn
    na yɛn bɔne enti woama yɛasɛe.

Mma wo bo mfu ntra so, Ao Awurade;
    nkae yɛn bɔne da biara da.
  Ao, brɛ wʼani ase hwɛ yɛn, yɛsrɛ wo,
    ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ.

Wo nkuropɔn kronkron no adane anweatam;
    Sion mpo ayɛ anweatam, Yerusalem ada mpan.

Yɛn asɔredan kronkron a ɛwɔ animuonyam, faako a yɛn nananom yii wo ayɛ no,
    wɔde ogya ahye,
    na deɛ ɛsom bo ma yɛn no, abubu.

Yei nyinaa akyi, Ao Awurade wo de wo ho bɛkame yɛn anaa?
    Wobɛkɔ so ayɛ komm atwe yɛn aso aboro so anaa?

“Medaa me ho adi kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔammisa mʼase;
    wɔn a wɔnhwehwɛ me no hunuu me.
  Ɔman a wɔnnsu mfrɛ me no
    Meka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Me nie, Me nie.’

Ɛda mu nyinaa, matrɛ me nsa mu ama
    nnipa a wɔyɛ asoɔden ne nyiyiano,
  a wɔnenam akwammɔne so,
    na wɔdi wɔn ankasa nsusuiɛ akyi.

Nnipa a daa no wɔyi me ahi
    wɔ mʼanim pɛɛ.
  Wɔbɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ nturo mu
    na wɔhye nnuhwam wɔ ntayaa afɔrebukyia so;

wɔka sɛ, ‘Momfiri ha; mo mmɛn me,
    ɛfiri sɛ me ho te dodo ma mo!’
  Saa nnipa yi yɛ wisie wɔ me hwene mu,
    ogya a ɛkɔ so hyeɛ da mu nyinaa.

mo ne mo agyanom bɔne nti,”
    sei na Awurade seɛ.
  “Esiane sɛ wɔhyee afɔrebɔdeɛ wɔ mmepɔ so
    na wɔtwirii me wɔ nkokoɔ so enti
  mɛsusu bɔne a wɔyɛɛ kane no so akatua pɛpɛɛpɛ
    agu wɔn asrɛ so.”

Yei ne deɛ Awurade seɛ:
  “Sɛdeɛ wɔnya nsuo firi bobe dontwo mu
    na nnipa ka sɛ, ‘Monnsɛe no,
    ɛfiri sɛ adepa bi da so wɔ mu’ no
  saa ara na mʼasomfoɔ no enti mɛyɛ.
    Merensɛe wɔn nyinaa.

Mede Yakob asefoɔ bɛba,
    na me mmepɔ no sodifoɔ afiri Yuda aba;
  me nkurɔfoɔ a mapa wɔn no bɛdi wɔn adeɛ,
    na ɛhɔ na mʼasomfoɔ bɛtena.

Saron bɛyɛ nnwankuo adidibea,
    na Akɔr bɔnhwa no ayɛ anantwikuo homebea,
    ama me nkurɔfoɔ a wɔhwehwɛ me.

“Na mo a mogya Awurade
    na mo werɛ firi ne bepɔ kronkron no,
  mo a moto ɛpono ma Ahonya bosom no
    na mohyɛ afransa wɔ nkuruwa mu ma Nkrabea bosom no,

mede mo bɛto akofena ano,
    na mo nyinaa akoto ama wɔakum mo;
  ɛfiri sɛ mefrɛeɛ nanso moannye so,
    mekasaeɛ nanso moantie.
  Moyɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ mʼani so bɔne
    na moyɛɛ deɛ mempɛ.”

Enti yei ne deɛ Otumfoɔ Awurade seɛ:
  “Mʼasomfoɔ bɛdidi,
    nanso ɛkɔm bɛde wɔn,
  mʼasomfoɔ bɛnom,
    nanso osukɔm bɛde wɔn;
  mʼasomfoɔ ani bɛgye,
    nanso wɔn anim bɛgu ase.

Mʼasomfoɔ bɛto nnwom
    afiri akoma mu anigyeɛ mu
  na wɔbɛteam asu
    afiri wɔn akoma ahoyera mu
    na wɔbɛtwa adwo afiri honhom a ayɛ mmrɛ mu.

Mo din bɛyɛ mmusuo
    ama wɔn a mapa wɔn;
  Otumfoɔ Awurade bɛkum mo
    na nʼasomfoɔ deɛ, ɔbɛma wɔn edin foforɔ.

Obiara a ɔsrɛ nhyira wɔ asase no so
    bɛyɛ wɔ nokorɛ Onyankopɔn mu;
  obiara a ɔka ntam wɔ asase no so
    bɛka no wɔ nokorɛ Onyankopɔn mu.
  Na ɔhaw a atwam no, wɔn werɛ bɛfiri
    na me nso, me werɛ bɛfiri.

“Hwɛ! Mɛbɔ
    ɔsorosoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ.
  Wɔrenkae nneɛma a atwam no bio,
    na ɛremma adwene mu nso.

Nanso momma mo ani nnye na monni ahurisie afebɔɔ
    wɔ deɛ merebɛbɔ ho,
  ɛfiri sɛ mɛbɔ Yerusalem ama ayɛ anika
    na emu nnipa ayɛ anigyeɛ farebae.

Mɛsɛpɛ me ho wɔ Yerusalem mu,
    na madi ahurisie wɔ me nkurɔfoɔ ho.
  Na wɔrente agyaadwoɔ ne osu nnyegyeeɛ
    wɔ mu bio.

“Ɛrensi bio wɔ mu.
    Abɔfra a ne nkwa nna yɛ kakraa bi,
    anaa akɔkoraa a ɔnni ne mfeɛ nwieeɛ,
  deɛ ɔdi mfeɛ ɔha na ɔwu no
    wɔbɛfa no sɛ ɔbabunu bi kɛkɛ;
  na deɛ wannya mfeɛ ɔha no
    wɔbɛfa no sɛ wɔadome no.

Wɔbɛsisi afie na wɔatena mu,
    wɔbɛyɛ bobe nturo na wɔadi mu aba.

Wɔrensisi afie mma afoforɔ mmɛtena mu bio,
    na wɔrennua mma afoforɔ mmɛdi.
  Na nna a nnua di no,
    saa ara na me nkurɔfoɔ nna bɛyɛ;
  me nkurɔfoɔ a mapa wɔn no bɛdi
    wɔn nsa ano adwuma so aba akyɛre.

Wɔremmrɛ nnwu
    na wɔrenwo mma a wɔn hyɛberɛ nnyɛ;
  ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nnipa a Awurade ahyira wɔn,
    wɔne wɔn asefoɔ.

Mɛbua wɔn ansa na wɔafrɛ me.
    Ɛberɛ a wɔgu so rekasa no, mɛtie.

Pataku ne odwammaa bɛdidi abɔ mu;
    gyata bɛwe ɛserɛ sɛ ɔnantwie,
  nanso mfuturo bɛyɛ ɔwɔ aduane.
    Wɔrempira obi anaa wɔrensɛe obi
  wɔ me bepɔ kronkron so nyinaa,”
    sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie.

Yei ne deɛ Awurade seɛ:
  “Ɔsoro yɛ mʼahennwa,
    na asase yɛ me nan ntiasoɔ.
  Ɛdan bɛn na wobɛsi ama me?
    Wobɛtumi asi ahomegyebea ama me?

Ɛnyɛ me nsa na ɛyɛɛ yeinom nyinaa,
    ɛna enti ɛbaa mu anaa?”
    Awurade na ɔseɛ.
    
  “Obi a mʼani sɔ no nie:
    deɛ ɔwɔ ahobrɛaseɛ ne ahonu honhom,
    na ne ho popo wɔ mʼasɛm ho.

Nanso, obi a ɔde nantwinini bɔ afɔdeɛ no
    saa ɔnipa no afɔdeɛ te sɛ onipa a wɔakum no de no abɔ afɔdeɛ,
  na deɛ ɔde odwammaa ba no,
    saa onipa no afɔdeɛ te sɛ ɔkraman a wɔakum no de no abɔ afɔdeɛ;
  deɛ ɔbɔ aduane afɔdeɛ no
    saa onipa no afɔdeɛ te sɛ prako mogya a wɔde bɔ afɔdeɛ,
  deɛ ɔhye nnuhwam a ɛwɔ din no
    saa onipa no afɔdeɛ no te sɛ deɛ wɔde som ɔbosom.
  Wɔafa wɔn ankasa akwan
    na wɔn ɔkra ani gye wɔn akyiwadeɛ ho;

enti me nso mɛpɛ aniɛyaadeɛ ayɛ wɔn
    na mede deɛ wɔsuro bɛba wɔn so.
  Ɛfiri sɛ mefrɛeɛ no, obiara annye so,
    mekasaeɛ no, obiara antie.
  Wɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ mʼani so
  na wɔyɛɛ deɛ mempɛ.”

Montie Awurade asɛm,
    mo a mote nʼasɛm a mo ho popo:
  “Mo nuanom mmarimma a me din enti wɔtane mo
    na wɔatwa mo agya no, wɔka sɛ,
  ‘Monhyɛ Awurade animuonyam,
    na yɛahunu mo anigyeɛ!’
    Nanso wɔn anim bɛgu ase.

Montie hooyɛ a ɛfiri kuropɔn no mu,
    montie gyegyeegye a ɛfiri asɔredan no mu!
  Ɛyɛ Awurade nnyegyeeɛ
    a ɔde retua nʼatamfoɔ ka sɛdeɛ ɛfata wɔn.

“Ansa na ɔbaa bɛkyem no,
    ɔwo;
  ansa na ɔbɛte awoɔyaa no,
    ɔwo ɔbabarima.

Hwan na wate biribi sei ho asɛm pɛn?
    Hwan na wahunu biribi sei pɛn?
  Wɔbɛtumi de da koro akyekyere ɔmansin
    anaa wɔbɛtumi akyekyere ɔman ɛberɛ sin bi mu?
  Nanso awoɔ ka Sion ara pɛ a
    ɔwo ne mma.

Mede obi bɛduru awokoɔ ano a
    memma no nwo anaa?” Sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie.
  “Mesi awotwaa ano
    ɛberɛ a awoɔ aduru so anaa?” Wo Onyankopɔn na ɔseɛ.

Mo ne Yerusalem ani nnye na monni ahurisie mma no,
    mo a modɔ no nyinaa;
  mo ne no nsɛpɛ mo ho yie,
    mo a modi ne ho awerɛhoɔ nyinaa.

Mobɛnum nʼawerɛkyekyerɛ nufoɔ
    no amee;
  mobɛnom aboro so
    na mo ani bɛgye deɛ abu so atra so no ho.

Na yei ne deɛ Awurade seɛ:
  “Mede asomdwoeɛ bɛma no sɛ asubɔnten,
    ne amanaman no ahonya nso sɛ asutene a ayiri.
  Mobɛnum na waturu mo wɔ ne basa so
    na ɔbɛgye mo agorɔ wɔ nʼanankoroma so.

Sɛ mohunu yei a, mo akoma ani bɛgye
    na mobɛyɛ frɔmm sɛ ɛserɛ;
  wɔbɛhunu Awurade nsa wɔ ne nkoa so,
    nanso wɔbɛhunu nʼabufuhyeɛ wɔ nʼatamfoɔ so.

Hwɛ, Awurade de ogya reba,
    na ne nteaseɛnam te sɛ ntwahoframa;
  ɔde nʼabufuo bɛba wɔ anibereɛ so,
    na ɔde gyadɛreeɛ ayɛ nʼanimka.

Ogya ne nʼakofena
    na Awurade de bɛbu nnipa nyinaa atɛn,
    na wɔn a wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ Awurade nsa ano bɛyɛ bebree.
“Wɔn a wɔte wɔn ho na wɔdwira wɔn ho de kɔ nturo mu kɔsom abosom no, na wɔwe prakonam ne akusie ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ no, wɔn nyinaa bɛhunu wɔn awieeɛ,” sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie.
“Esiane wɔn nneyɛɛ ne wɔn nsusuiɛ enti, me, mereba abɛboaboa amanaman ne kasa ahodoɔ ano, na wɔbɛba abɛhunu mʼanimuonyam.

“Na mɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi wɔ wɔn mu, na mede nkaeɛfoɔ no mu bi bɛkɔ amanaman no mu: Tarsis, Libiafoɔ ne Lidiafoɔ (wɔn a wɔagye edin wɔ agyantoɔ mu), Tubal ne Helafoɔ, ne nsupɔ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri a wɔntee me din a ahyeta na wɔnhunuu mʼanimuonyam. Wɔbɛpae mu aka mʼanimuonyam wɔ amanaman mu.

Na wɔde mo nuammarimanom nyinaa bɛfiri amanaman nyinaa so bɛba me bepɔ kronkron a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no so sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ ama Awurade. Wɔtete apɔnkɔ so ne nteaseɛnam mu ne asako mu ne mfunumpɔnkɔ ne nyoma so bɛba,” sei na Awurade seɛ. “Wɔde wɔn bɛba sɛdeɛ Israelfoɔ de wɔn aduane afɔdeɛ kɔ Awurade asɔredan mu, wɔ afahyɛ nkuruwa a ɛho teɛ mu.
Na mɛyi wɔn mu bi ayɛ asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ,” Awurade, na ɔseɛ!
“Sɛdeɛ ɔsorosoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ bɛtena hɔ no, saa ara na mo din ne mo asefoɔ bɛtena hɔ,” sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie.
“Ɛfiri Ɔsrane Foforɔ baako kɔpem foforɔ, ɛfiri Homeda baako kɔsi foforɔ no, adasamma nyinaa bɛba abɛkoto me,” sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie.
“Na wɔbɛfiri adi akɔhunu wɔn a wɔtee atua tiaa me no afunu; wɔn asonsono renwu, na wɔn ogya nso rennum, na wɔn ho bɛyɛ adasamma nyinaa nwunu.”
Ɛberɛ a Usia babarima Yotam babarima Ahas bɛdii Yudaman so ɔhene no, Aramhene Resin ne Remalia babarima Peka a ɔyɛ Israelhene baa Yerusalem ne wɔn bɛkoeɛ, nanso wɔantumi anni ne so.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid fie sɛ, “Aram ne Efraim ayɛ apam.” Enti Ahas ne ne nkurɔfoɔ ho wosoeɛ sɛdeɛ kwaeɛm nnua woso wɔ mframa ano no.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia sɛ, “Wo ne wo babarima Sear-Yasub nkɔhyia Ahas wɔ Atifi Tadeɛ no subɔnka a ɛwɔ Ntomasifoɔ Afuo no kwan so.
Ka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Hwɛ yie, yɛ komm na nsuro. Mma wʼakoma ntu wɔ saa nnyentia mmienu a ɛrefiri wisie yi ho; wɔ Resin Aramhene ne Remalia babarima abufuhyeɛ no enti.
Aram, Efraim ne Remalia babarima abɔ wo sɛeɛ ho pɔ sɛ,
“Momma yɛnto nhyɛ Yuda so, na yɛntete wɔn mu na yɛnkyɛ mfa, na yɛnsi Tabeel babarima ɔhene wɔ so.”

Nanso deɛ Asafo Awurade seɛ nie:
  “ ‘Ɛremma so,
    na ɛrensi da,

Aram tiri ne Damasko,
    na Resin pɛ na ɛyɛ Damasko ti.
  Mfirinhyia aduosia enum mu no
    Efraim mu bɛtete koraa a ɛrentumi nnyɛ ɔman.

Efraim tiri ne Samaria
    Remalia babarima pɛ ne Samaria ti.
  Sɛ woannyina pintinn wɔ wo gyidie mu a,
    worennyina koraa.’ ”
Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ Ahas bio sɛ,
“Bisa Awurade wo Onyankopɔn hɔ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, sɛ ɛwɔ ebunu ase tɔnn anaa ɔsorosoro nohoa.”
Nanso, Ahas buaa sɛ, “Meremmisa. Merensɔ Awurade nhwɛ.”
Na Yesaia kaa sɛ, “Montie Dawid fie! Ɛnnɔɔso mma mo sɛ mobɛsɔ nnipa ntoboaseɛ ahwɛ? Na mobɛsɔ me Onyankopɔn nso ntoboaseɛ ahwɛ anaa?
Ɛnneɛ, Onyankopɔn ankasa bɛma mo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ; ɔbaabunu no bɛnyinsɛn, na wawo ɔbabarima, na ɔbɛfrɛ no Immanuel.
Ɔbɛdi nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne ɛwoɔ ɛberɛ a wahunu deɛ ɛbɛma watumi apo bɔne na wafa deɛ ɛyɛ.
Nanso, ansa na abarimaa no bɛhunu deɛ ɛbɛma watumi apo bɔne na wafa deɛ ɛyɛ no, wɔbɛma ahemfo mmienu a wosuro wɔn no nsase ada mpan.
Awurade de ɛberɛ bi bɛba wo ne wo nkurɔfoɔ ne wʼagya fie so a ɛso bi mmaa da, ɛfiri ɛberɛ a Efraim tee ne ho firii Yuda ho; ɔde Asiriahene bɛba.”
Ɛda no, Awurade bɛhyɛn abɛn afrɛ nwansena afiri nsuwansuwa a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri wɔ Misraim ne nwowa a wɔfiri Asiria asase so.
Wɔn nyinaa bɛba abɛgu mmɔnhwa a emu dɔ ne ntokuro a ɛwɔ abotan mu, nkyɛkyerɛ ne nsuka mu.
Ɛda no, Awurade de oyiwan a ɔbɛgye wɔ Asubɔnten no agya nohoa wɔ Asiriahene nkyɛn, na ɔde ayi motiri so ne monan ho nwi na wayi mo abɔgyesɛ nso.
Saa ɛda no, obiara bɛyɛn nantwiburuwa baako ne mpɔnkye mmienu.
Na ɛsiane nufosuo dodoɔ a wɔbɛma enti, ɔbɛnya nufosuo ani sradeɛ adi. Wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔ asase no so nyinaa bɛdi nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne ɛwoɔ.
Saa ɛda no, baabiara a na anka bobe apem a ne boɔ yɛ dwetɛ kilogram dubaako ne fa wɔ no, wɔbɛhunu nnɛnkyɛnse ne nkasɛɛ.
Nnipa de agyan ne tadua bɛkɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ nnɛnkyɛnse ne nkasɛɛ agye hɔ.
Nkokoɔ a na anka kane no wɔde nsɔ yɛ so adwuma no, nnɛnkyɛnse ne nkasɛɛ ho hu enti wɔrenkɔ hɔ bio. Ɛbɛdane mmeammea a wogyaa anantwie ne nnwan ma wɔkɔ.
Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Fa nwoma mmobɔeɛ kɛseɛ no na fa twerɛdua biara twerɛ so.
Na mɛfrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Uria ne Yeberekia babarima Sakaria sɛ mʼadansefoɔ nokwafoɔ aba.”
Afei mekɔɔ nkɔmhyɛni baa no ho, na ɔnyinsɛneeɛ, woo ɔbabarima. Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Frɛ no Maher-Salal-Has-Bas.
Ansa na abarimaa no bɛtumi aka, ‘Mʼagya’ anaa sɛ ‘me maame’ no, Asiriahene bɛba abɛfa Damasko ahodeɛ ne Samaria afodeɛ nyinaa akɔ.”
Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ me bio sɛ,

“Esiane sɛ saa nkurɔfoɔ yi apo
    Siloa nsuo a ɛresene brɛoo
  na wɔdi ahurisie wɔ Resin
    ne Remalia babarima no ho enti,

Awurade reyɛ de Asubɔnten no
    yire kɛseɛ no atia wɔn,
  Asiriahene ne ne kɛseyɛ nyinaa.
    Ɛbɛyiri afa ne mmɔnka nyinaa mu,
    na abu afa ne nkonkɔn so

na apra abɛfa Yuda, akontono afa ho,
    atene afa mu abɛdeda ɛkɔn mu.
  Na atrɛtrɛ akata asase no nyinaa so
    Ao Immanuel.”

Momma ɔko nteamu so, mo aman na wɔndwɛre mo!
    Montie mo akyirikyiri aman.
  Monsiesie mo ho mma ɔko, na wɔndwɛre mo!
    Monsiesie mo ho mma ɔko, na wɔndwɛre mo!
Awurade de ne nsa denden no too me so, ka kyerɛ me bɔɔ me kɔkɔ sɛ, mennante saa nkurɔfoɔ yi kwan so. Ɔkaa sɛ,

“Ɛnyɛ biribiara a saa nkurɔfoɔ yi frɛ no tirisopam
    na ɛyɛ tirisopam.
  Monnsuro deɛ wosuro,
    na momma ɛmmɔ mo hu.

Asafo Awurade nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wobu no kronkron,
    ɔno na ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro no,
    ɔno na ne ho yɛ hu,

ɔbɛyɛ kronkronbea:
    nanso Israel afie mmienu no deɛ,
  ɔbɛyɛ suntiboɔ
    ne ɔbotan a ɛma wɔhwe ase.
  Na ne nnipa a ɛwɔ Yerusalem deɛ
    ɔbɛyɛ afidie a ɛbɛyi wɔn.

Kyekyere adanseɛ no
    sɔ mmara no ano ma mʼasuafoɔ.

Mɛtwɛn Awurade
    a wayi nʼani afiri Yakob efie so
    mede me werɛ bɛhyɛ ne mu.
Me ne mma a Awurade de wɔn ama me no nie. Yɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ Israel, na yɛfiri Asafo Awurade a ɔte Sion Bepɔso no nkyɛn.
Sɛ nnipa tu mo fo sɛ monkɔ hunu asamanfrɛfoɔ ne nnunsifoɔ a wɔkasa aso mu na emu nteɛ a, adɛn enti na wɔmmmisa wɔn Onyankopɔn? Adɛn enti na mobisa adeɛ wɔ awufoɔ nkyɛn ma ateasefoɔ?
Sɛ wɔannyina mmara ne adanseɛ yi so anka asɛm yi a, wonni adekyeɛ mu hann.
Wɔde ahohiahia ne ɛkɔm bɛnantenante asase no so; na sɛ wɔtɔ baha a, wɔn bo bɛfu na wɔbɛma wɔn ani so adome wɔn ɔhene ne wɔn Onyankopɔn.
Afei wɔbɛhwɛ asase no so, na wobɛhunu ahohiahia ne esum a ɛyɛ hu, na wɔde wɔn bɛhyɛne esum kabii mu.

Nanso, wɔn a na wɔwɔ ahohiahia mu no, wɔrenni awerɛhoɔ bio. Kane no ɔbrɛɛ Sebulon ne Naftali nsase no ase, nanso daakye bi ɔbɛhyɛ Galilea a ɛyɛ amanamanmufoɔ ɔman na ne kwan da Yordan ne ɛpo ntam no animuonyam.

Nnipa a wɔnam sum mu
    ahunu hann kɛseɛ;
  wɔn a wɔte asase a ɛso sum kabii soɔ no,
    hann bi apue wɔn so.

Sɛdeɛ da a Midian dii nkoguo no,
    saa ara na woadwɛre kɔnnua a ɛda wɔn so no;
  saa ara na woayi nhyɛsofoɔ poma
    a ɛda wɔn mmatire so.

Ɔkofoɔ mpaboa a wɔhyɛ de kɔ sa
    ne atadeɛ biara a mogya akeka mu no
  wɔbɛgya agu hɔ na wɔahye.
    Wɔde bɛsɔ ogya.

Ɛfiri sɛ, wɔawo akokoaa ama yɛn,
    wɔama yɛn ɔbabanin,
  na amammuo no bɛda ne mmati so.
    Na wɔbɛfrɛ no
  Ɔfotufoɔ Nwanwani, Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn,
    Daa Agya, Asomdwoeɛ Wura.

Nʼamammuo no nkɔsoɔ ne nʼasomdwoeɛ
    bɛtena hɔ daa.
  Ɔbɛtena Dawid ahennwa so
    abu nʼahennie,
  Ɔde atɛntenenee ne teneneeyɛ
    bɛhyɛ aseɛ na wama atim
  afiri saa ɛberɛ no akɔsi daa apem.
    Asafo Awurade mmɔdemmɔ
    bɛyɛ yei.

Awurade ato Yakob nkra a ɛtia no,
    na ɛbɛka Israel.

Nnipa no nyinaa bɛhunu,
    Efraim ne wɔn a wɔtete Samaria
  a wɔde ahohoahoa
    ne ahomasoɔ akoma kasa no,

“Ntayaa no abubu agu fam
    nanso yɛde aboɔ a wɔatwa bɛto bio.
  Wɔabubu borɔdɔma nnua no
    nanso yɛde ntweneduro bɛsi anan mu.”

Nanso Awurade ahyɛ Resin atamfoɔ den atia wɔn,
    na ɔhyɛ wɔn atamfoɔ no nkuran.

Aramfoɔ a wɔfiri apueeɛ fam,
    Filistifoɔ a wɔfiri atɔeɛ fam,
    abue wɔn anom amene Israel.
    
  Nanso yeinom nyinaa akyiri no ne bo nnwooɛ
    na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.

Nanso nnipa no nsane nkɔɔ deɛ ɔtwee wɔn aso no nkyɛn,
    na wɔmmpɛɛ Asafo Awurade no akyiri kwan nso.

Enti Awurade bɛtwa etire ne dua afiri Israel ho
    na ɛberɛ ne demmire nso, ɔde da koro pɛ bɛtwa;

mpanimfoɔ ne akunini no ne etire no,
    na atorɔ adiyifoɔ no ne dua no.

Wɔn a wɔkyerɛ nnipa yi kwan no nnkyerɛ wɔn kwan pa,
    na wɔn a wɔnya akwankyerɛ no nso fom kwan.

Enti Awurade ani rennye mmeranteɛ no ho,
    na ɔrenhunu nwisiaa ne akunafoɔ mmɔbɔ
  ɛfiri sɛ, obiara nni nyamesu na wɔyɛ amumuyɛfoɔ.
    Ano biara ka ahuhusɛm.
    
  Nanso yeinom nyinaa akyi no, ne bo nnwooɛ,
    na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.

Nokorɛm atirimuɔden hye te sɛ ogya;
    ɛhye nnɛnkyɛnse ne nkasɛɛ,
  ɛde ogya to kwaeɛbirentuo mu hye no,
    na ɛnam wisie kumɔnn mu foro kɔ soro.

Asafo Awurade abufuo so enti,
    asase no bɛkyene
  na nnipa bɛyɛ mmabaa ama ogya no;
    na obiara remfa ne nua ho nkyɛ no.

Nifa so, wɔbɛfom aduane adi,
    nanso ɛkɔm bɛde wɔn;
  benkum so, wɔbɛdidi,
    nanso wɔremmee.
  Obiara bɛwe ne ba ɛnam.

Manase bɛdane Efraim na Efraim adane Manase
    na wɔbɛbɔ mu atia Yuda.
    
  Nanso yeinom nyinaa akyi no, ne bo nnwoeɛ,
    na wama ne nsa so ayɛ krado.
